Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 8: Shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel hekdesh o shor shel hekdesh shennagach shor shel yisrael patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 la)</small> "shor reehu". vechol hakkadashim shechayyavin bahen meila en bahen din nezakin. ufesule hammukdashin yesh bahen din nezakin ben shehizziku ben shehuzzeku shehare yatzu lappidyon velihyotam chullin:

Shelamim shehizziku gove mibbesaram veeno gove min habbasar keneged emurehen. shehaemurim shel kadashim kallim moalin bahen kemo shebbearnu behilchot meila. vechen toda shehizzika gove mibbesarah veeno gove min hallechem habba immah sheen hallechem mikkelal basar:

Vechetzad gove. sheyyochal hannizzak vachavurato min habbasar bikdushsha keneged chatzi nezek shello. vechetzad eno gove keneged haemurin. sheim haya lo ligbot bachatzi nizko sheve dinar vehaya kol habbasar im haemurin shave shene dinarim vehabbasar belo emurin shave dinar vachetzi eno gove shene shelishi habbasar ella chatzi habbasar bilvad:

Vechen shor hefker shehizzik patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 la)</small> "shor reehu" ad sheyyihyu hannechasim meyuchadim labbealim. ketzad. shor hahefker shennagach vekodem sheyyitposho oto hannizzak ba acher vezacha bo hare ze patur. velo od ella shor hameyuchad labbealim shehizzik veachar shehizzik hakedisho o hifkiro hare ze patur ad sheyyihyu lo bealim bishat hezzeko uvishat haamada baddin:

Shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel akkum ben tam ben muad patur. lefi sheen haakkum mechayyevin et haadam al behemto shehizzika vahare anu danin lahem kedinehem. veshor shel akkum shennagach shel yisrael ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem. kenas hu ze leakkum lefi sheenan zehirin bemitzvot veenan mesallekin hannezek veim lo techayyev otan al nizke behemtan en meshammerin otah umafsidin mamon habberiyyot:

Shor tam shehizzik im mecharo hammazzik ad shello amad baddin af al pi shehu machur hare hannizzak gove hemennu vechozer hallokeach vegove min hammazzik shemmachar lo. shekkevan shennagach kol yesh lo velo haya lo lallokeach likkach ad sheyyigbe hannizzak:
Hikdisho hammazzik hare ze mukdash kede shello yomru hekdesh yotze belo pidyon. shechato gove mibbesaro. netano bemattana ma sheasa asuy veyigbe hannizzak mimmennu:

Hizzik veamad baddin veachar kach mecharo eno machur. hikdisho eno mukdash. netano bemattana lo asa velo kelum. kadmu baale chovot shel mazzik utefasuhu ben shechav ad shello hizzik ben hizzik ad shello chav lo zachu ella hannizzak gove mimmennu sheafillu haya shel baale chovot mittechilla vehizzik hare ze gove miggufo:

Muad shehizzik ben amad baddin ben shello amad baddin vehikdisho o mecharo o netano bemattana o shechato. ma sheasa asuy. kadmu baale chovot vehinhiguhu ben chav ad shello hizzik ben hizzik ad shello chav zachu bo. lefi sheen mishtallem hannizzak ella min hameulle shebbenichse hammazzik vahare kol nechasav meshubadin lenezek ze:

Keshebbet din nizkakin ligbot lannizzak minnichse hammazzik govin min hammittaltelin techilla veim lo hayu lo mittaltelin kelal o shello hayu lo mittaltelin keneged kol hannezek govin hashshear min hakkarka hameulla shebbenichse hammazzik. vechol zeman sheyyimtzeu mittaltelin vaafillu subbin en nizkakin lakkarka:

Met hammazzik kodem sheyyeshallem en bet din nizkakin lammittaltelin shel yetomim ella lakkarka. vegovin lannizzak min hazzibburit. mippene shehannizak naasa kevaal chov vehammittaltelin enan meshubadin levaal chov. veim tafas hannizzak hammittaltelin bechayye hammazzik govin lo mehem leachar moto:

Kevar tikkenu haggeonim ligbot baal chov min hammittaltelin. ufashta takkana zo bechol batte dinin. lefichach megabbin hannezakin min hammittaltelin shel yetomim. veim lo hinniach mittaltelin govin lo min hazzibburit shekkol habba lippara minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella min hazzibburit kemo shebbearnu:

En hannezakin mishtallemin veen chayyavin bechofer veen habbehema nehereget ella biraya berura uveedim hakkesherim lehaid. shello tomar hoil veen metzuyin beurvot hassusim uverefet habbakar vegidrot tzon ella haavadim veharoim vechayyotze bahen im heidu shebbehema zo hizzika et zo shomin lahem veim heidu ketannim o nashim sheadam ze chaval et ze o heidu bishar nezakin somchin alehen. en haddavar ken. ella en mechayyevin leolam mamon al pi edim ad sheyyihyu edim hakkesherim lehaid shear eduyyot veyaidu vichayyevu bet din hammazzik leshallem:

Shor shehaya roe al gabbe hannahar venimtza shor harug betziddo. af al pi shezze menuggach veze muad liggach ze menushshach veze muad lishshach. en omrim beyadua shezze neshacho veze negacho. vaafillu gamal haocher ben haggemallim venimtza [gamal] harug betziddo en omrim beyadua shezze harago ad sherauhu edim kesherim:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 9:
Behema meubberet shehizzika gove chatzi nezek mimmenna umivveladah mippene shehu miggufah. aval tarnegolet shehizzika eno gove mibbetzatah mippene shehabbetza enah miggufah aval muvdelet umufreshet mimmenna: 
Meubberet shennagcha venimtza veladah betziddah veen yadua im ad shello nagcha yalda o achar shennagcha yalda. meshallem chatzi nezek min happara veeno gove min havvalad kelum ad sheyyavi reaya shebbeshaa shennagcha hayta meubberet. shehammotzi mechavero alav lehavi haraya: 
Shor shennagach para meubberet venimtza ubbarah nofel betziddah veen yadua im ad shello negachah hippila o mechamat negicha hippila. meshallem nezek happara veeno meshallem nezek havvalad. shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Nagach para meubberet vehippila. en shamin pechat para bifne atzmah ufechat havvalad bifne atzmo. ella shamin kamma hayta happara shava keshehayta meubberet uveria vechamma hi shava achshav hi vehannefel shellah umeshallem happechat o chetzyo im haya tam: 
Hayta happara leechad vehavvalad leechad hare pechat hashshumman sheppachat guf happara levaal happara. ufechat hannefach cholkin oto baal happara im baal havvalad. vehannefel shel baal havvalad: 
Shor shehaya rodef achar shor acher vehuzzak. hannizzak omer shorcha hizzik veze omer eni yodea shemma besela laka. hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. veaf al pi shehannizak omer eni yodea bevadday veze omer eni yodea. taan hannizzak veamar vadday atta yodea sheshshorcha hizzik hare ze nishba shevuat hesset sheeno yodea im haya muad. aval im haya tam patur af mishshevuat hesset sheafillu hoda meatzmo patur shechatzi nezek kenas hu umode biknas patur hu: 
Hayu shenayim rodfin achar echad vahare edim sheechad mehen hizzik veen haedim yodim ezehu mishshenehem. ze omer shorcha hizzik veze omer shorcha hizzik shenehem peturin. veim hayu shenehem shel ish echad chayyav leshallem migguf happachut shebbishnehem. veim hayu muadin meshallem nezek shalem minnechasav: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheshshene hashshevarim omdin. aval im met echad mehen o avad vehaya echad mehen tam af al pi shehen shel ish echad patur. shehare omer lo have reaya shezze haomed hu shehizzik vaashallem lecha: 
Hayu shene hashshevarim harodfin echad gadol veechad katan. hannizzak omer gadol hizzik vehammazzik omer katan hizzik. haya echad tam veechad muad hannizzak omer muad hizzik vehammazzik omer tam hizzik. hammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Lo hayta sham reaya berura shezze hizzik ella edim meidim sheechad mishshene ellu hizzik meshallem hammazzik kemo sheomer. veim taan hannizzak sheatta yodea vadday shezze hizzik befanecha hare hammazzik nishba shevuat hattora umeshallem kemo shehoda shehare hoda bemiktzat: 
Hayu hannizzakin shenayim echad gadol veechad katan vehammazzikin echad gadol veechad katan. hannizzak omer gadol hizzik et haggadol vehakkatan et hakkatan vehammazzik omer lo ki ella katan hizzik et haggadol vegadol et hakkatan. o shehaya echad tam veechad muad hannizzak omer hammuad hizzik et haggadol vetam hizzik et hakkatan vehammazzik omer tam hizzik et haggadol vehammuad hizzik et hakkatan. hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. lo hayta sham reaya berura hammazzik patur. lema ze dome leze toen et chavero chittim vehoda lo bisorim shehu nishba shevuat hesset ufatur af middeme seorim kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot toen. veim tafas hannizzak hare ze meshallem lakkatan min haggadol velaggadol min hakkatan kemo shehoda hammazzik. aval im lo tafas en motziin min hammazzik kelum: 
Shor shennagach vechazar venagach shor acher hare hannizzak harishon vehabbealim shuttafin bo. ketzad. shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim veen hannevela yafa kelum hannizzak notel mea uvaal hashshor mea. chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim veen hannevela yafa kelum haacharon notel mea vehannizzak shellefanav im habbealim notlin chamishshim chamishshim zuz. chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim veen hannevela yafa kelum haacharon notel mea venizzak shellefanav chamishshim vehannizzak harishon im habbealim esrim vachamishsha esrim vachamishsha. vechen al derech zo cholkin veholchim: 
Nizzak shettafas behema shehizzika ligbot chatzi nizko miggufah naasa aleha shomer sachar linzakin veim yatzta vehizzika hannizzak harishon chayyav binzakeha vehabbealim peturin. ketzad. shor shave matayim shennagach vehifsid matayim utefaso hannizzak ligbot mimmennu mea vechazar venagach vehifsid bemea vearbaim hare hannizzak haacharon mishtallem shivim vehannizzak harishon shettefaso mishtallem motar nizko vehu sheloshim vehabbealim mea. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shene shevarim tammim shechavlu ze baze meshallemin bammotar chatzi nezek. shenehem muadin (o muad veadam) shechavlu ze baze meshallemin bammotar nezek shalem. echad tam veechad muad. muad betam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem tam bemuad meshallem bammotar chatzi nezek. ketzad. shor tam shehifsid beshor tam acher sheve mane vechazar ze haacharon vehifsid barishon sheve arbaim hare baal harishon meshallem labbaal haacharon sheloshim. hayu shenehem muadin baal harishon meshallem shishshim. harishon muad veacharon tam baal harishon meshallem shemonim. harishon tam vehaacharon muad baal harishon meshallem asara:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 10:
Shor shehemit et haadam bechol makom ben gadol ben katan ben eved ben ben chorin echad tam veechad muad hare ze niskal. veim hemit et haakkum patur kedinehem: 
Echad shor veechad shear behema chayya veof shehemitu hare ellu niskalin. ma ben tam sheharag et haadam lemuad sheharag et haadam. shehattam patur min hakkofer vehammuad chayyav bechofer uvilvad sheyyihye muad laharog: 
Vehoil vechol behema chayya veof shehargu et haadam niskalin heach yimmatze muad laharog ad sheyyeshallemu bealav et hakkofer. kegon sheharag shelosha ovde kochavim veachar kach harag yisrael shehammuad leakkum hare ze muad leyisrael. o sheharag shelosha yisrael terefa veachar kach harag shalem. o sheharag uvarach uvarvii nitpas. sheen habbealim chayyavin bechofer ad sheyyissakel hashshor. vechen im sikken shelosha bene adam keechad o sheharag shalosh behemot hare ze muad lahariga uvealim meshallemin et hakkofer. vechen im hikkiru edim et baal hashshor velo hikkiru et hashshor befaam rishona usheniyya ushelishit uvarviit rau shoro sheharag velo hayu yodin im ze hu hashshor sheharag beshalosh peamim harishonot o acher haya. hoil vehuadu habbealim sheyyesh lahem bivkaram shor sheharag shalosh peamim haya lahem lishmor kol behemtam umeachar shello shamru meshallemin et hakkofer: 
Ze shekkatuv battora <small>(Shemot 21 29)</small> "vegam bealav yumat" mippi hashshemua lamdu shechiyyuv mita zo bide shamayim veim natan kofer hanneherag mitkapper lo. veaf al pi shehakkofer kappara memashkenin mi shennitchayyev bechofer beal karcho: 
Shor shel shene shuttafin sheharag. kol echad mehem meshallem kofer shalem shehare kol echad mehen tzarich kappara gemura: 
En gomrin dino shel shor ella bifne bealav im hayu lo bealim. aval im lo hayu lo bealim kegon shor hammidbar veshor shel hekdesh veshor shel ger shemmet veen lo yorshin im hemit hare ze niskal vegomrin dino af al pi sheen lo bealim. vechen shor haishsha veshor hayetomim veshor haappotroppesim shehemitu niskalin. veen haappotroppesim meshallemin et hakkofer shehakkofer kappara hu veen hakketannim vehachershim vehashshotim bene chiyyuv kede sheyyihyu tzerichin kappara: 
Shor shehu terefa sheharag et hannefesh o shehaya hashshor shel adam terefa eno niskal shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 29)</small> "vegam bealav yumat" kemitat habbealim kach mitat hashshor. vechevan shebbealav kemet hem chashuvim veenan tzerichin mita hare ze patur: 
Hameshasse kelev bachavero vaharago en hakkelev niskal. vechen im gera bo behema o chayya vaharaguhu. aval im shissa bo nachash vaafillu hishshicho bo vaharago hannachash niskal. sheeres hannachash shemmemit meatzmo mekio lefichach ze haadam shehishshich bo nachash patur mimmitat bet din: 
En habbehema niskelet im hemita ad shennitkavvena lehazzik lemi shehi chayyevet alav sekila. aval shor shehaya mitkavven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam. nitkavvin leakkum veharag leyisrael. nitkavven linfalim veharag ben kayyama. patur min hammita. veim haya muad habbealim chayyavin bechofer. o biknas im hemit eved. veaf al pi sheharag belo kavvana hoil vehu muad laze: 
Haya muad lippol al bene haadam bevorot veraa yarak babbor venafal labbor bishvil hayyarak vehaya sham adam umet. o shehaya muad lehitchakkech bakketalim ulehappil al bene adam venitchakkech bakkotel lahanaato venafal al adam umet mechamat chikkucho. hashshor patur mimmita lefi shello nitkavven lehamit vehabbealim chayyavin bechofer shehare ze muad lippol bevorot al bene adam o lehappil alehem hakketalim. veheach yodea shennitchakkech lahanaato. keshennitchakkech leachar shehippil vehemit: 
En habbealim meshallemin et hakkofer ad shettamit behemtan chutz mershutan. aval im hemit birshut hammazzik af al pi shehu biskila habbealim peturin min hakkofer. ketzad. hannichnas lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshuto vaafillu nichnas litboa secharo o chovo mimmennu unegacho shoro shel baal habbayit umet. hashshor biskila vehabbealim peturin min hakkofer. shehare en lo reshut likkanes lirshuto shel ze shello middato: 
Amad bappetach vekara levaal habbayit veamar lo hen. venichnas unegacho shoro shel baal habbayit hare habbealim peturin. sheen mashma hen ella amod bimkomcha ad sheadabber immecha: 
Behema shennichnesa lachatzar hannizzak vedarsa al gabbe tinok derech hilluchah vaharagathu habbealim meshallemin et hakkofer sheharegel muedet lehazzik bederech hilluchah uvirshut hannizzak chayyav af al hashshen veal haregel kemo shebbearnu. nimtzeta lamed shehammuad shehemit bechavvana niskal vehabbealim chayyavin bechofer veim hemit shello bechavvana patur min hammita vehabbealim chayyavin bechofer. vetam shehemit shello bechavvana patur min hammita umin hakkofer. veim nitkavven lehamit niskal vehabbealim peturin min hakkofer vechen mikkenas shel eved: 
Nire li sheaf al pi shehattam shehemit bechavvana eved o shifcha patur min hakkenas shehu sheloshim sela hakkatuv battora. im hemit shello bechavvana meshallem chatzi deme haeved o chatzi deme hashshifcha miggufo keillu hemit shor chavero o chamoro:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 11:
Kamma hu hakkofer. kemo sherau haddayyanin shehu deme hanneherag hakkol lefi shavyo shel neherag shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 30)</small> "venatan pidyon nafsho kechol asher yushat alav". vechofer haavadim ben gedolim ben ketannim ben zecharim ben nekevot hu hakkenas hakkatzuv battora sheloshim sela kesef yafe ben shehaya haeved shave mea mane ben sheeno shave ella dinar. vechol hameukkav get shichrur en lo kenas hoil veen lo adon shehare yatza lecherut: 
Lemi notnin hakkofer. leyorshe hanneherag. veim hemit ishsha hakkofer leyorsheha meaviha veeno labbaal. hemit mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin noten chatzi kenas lerabbo vehachetzi haacher rauy litten veen mi yikkachennu: 
Shor shennagach ishsha veyatzu yeladeha af al pi shehu muad liggach habbealim peturin middeme veladot. shello chiyyeva tora bidme veladot ella laadam: 
Nagach shifcha veyatzu yeladeha meshallem deme veladot. shezze kemi shennagach chamor meubberet. veim haya tam meshallem chatzi deme veladot miggufo: 
Ketzad shamin otah. omdin kamma hayta shifcha zo shava keshehayta meebberet vechamma hi shava atta venoten livaleha happechat o chetzyo. veim hemit hashshifcha meshallem hakkofer hakkatzuv battora bilvad kemo shebbearnu: 
Shor shennitkavven livhema venagach et haadam af al pi sheim hemito patur kemo shebbearnu im chaval bo chayyav benezek. veim tam hu meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo. veim muad nezek shalem: 
Shor tam shehemit vehizzik danin oto dine nefashot veen danin oto dine mamonot. umuad shehemit vehizzik danin oto dine mamonot vechozrin vedanin oto dine nefashot. kadmu vedanuhu dine nefashot techilla chozrin vedanin oto dine mamonot: 
Umehechan mishtallem min hashshevach shehishbiach birdiyyato achar shennigmar dino. shekkevan shennigmar dino liskila en lo bealim sheyyitchayyevu binzakav. danuhu dine nefashot uvarach en danin oto dine mamonot: 
Shor shehemit et haadam vehikdisho bealav eno kadosh. vechen im hifkiro eno mufkar. mecharo eno machur. hecheziro shomer livalav enah chazara. shechato besaro asur bahanaa. bamme devarim amurim achar shennigmar dino liskila. aval ad shello nigmar dino liskila im hikdisho mukdash veim hifkiro hare hu mufkar. mecharo hare ze machur. hecheziro shomer livalav hare ze muchzar. veim kadam ushechato hare ze muttar baachila: 
Shor shello nigmar dino shennitarev bishvarim acherim kullan peturin lefi sheen gomrin dino shel shor ella bifne hashshor kedin haadam. nigmar dino veachar kach nitarev baacherim afillu beelef kullan niskalim venikbarin vaasurin bahanaa kedin behema niskelet: 
Para meubberet shehemita et haadam vechen kol behema shenneevda bah avera hare ebbarah kamoha. hi veebbarah nagcha hi veubbarah nirbea: 
Nagcha vehemita veachar kach nitabbera. im ad shello nigmar dinah nitabbera veyalda kodem gemar din veladah muttar veim yalda achar gemar din veladah asur shehaubbar yerech immo hu. veim nitarev valad ze baacherim konsin et kullam bechippa ad sheyyamutu sham: 
Shor hanniskal shehuzammu edav kol hakkodem bo zacha shehare mishshennigmar dino hifkiruhu bealav. veim heidu shebbealav ribbeahu vehezim et haedim hare hashshor livalav vehakkodem umeshacho lo zacha bo shekkevan shehabbaal yodea beatzmo shello chata vesheellu ede sheker hem vahare hu meyachel lahazimam lo hifkir:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 12:
Hachofer bor birshut harabbim venafal letocho shor o chamor umet afillu haya habbor male gizzot shel tzemer vechayyotze bahen hare baal habbor chayyav leshallem nezek shalem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 34)</small> "baal habbor yeshallem". veechad shor vachamor o shear mine behema chayya veof lo neemar <small>(Shemot 21 33)</small> "shor vachamor" ella bahove: 
Echad hachofer bor birshut harabbim o hachofer bor birshuto ufitcho lirshut harabbim o patach lirshut chavero o shechafar ufatach lirshuto vehifkir reshuto velo hifkir boro hare ze chayyav binzakav. aval im hifkir reshuto uvoro o shehifkir boro shebbirshuto o hikdisho hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 34)</small> "baal habbor yeshallem" mi sheyyesh lo bealim veze hefker uvattechilla birshut chafar mippene shechafar birshuto: 
Echad hachofer bor o shennechpar meelav o shechafarattu behema o chayya hoil vehu chayyav lemalleoto o lechassoto velo asa hare ze chayyav binzakav. vechad hachofer o hallokeach o shennittan lo bemattana shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 34)</small> "baal habbor yeshallem" mi sheyyesh lo bealim mikkol makom: 
Echad hachofer o hamegalle makom shehaya mechusse shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 33)</small> "chi yiftach ish bor o ki yichre". veim chissahu karauy af al pi shehitlia mittocho venafal letocho shor umet patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 33)</small> "velo yechassennu" ha im kissahu patur. kissahu bedavar sheyyachol laamod bifne shevarim veeno yachol laamod bifne gemallim vehalchu alav gemallim venitroea vehalchu alav shevarim venaflu bo. im en haggemallim metzuyin beoto makom hare ze patur mippene shezze ones. veim yavou sham gemallim afillu lifrakim hare ze chayyav: 
Hitlia mittocho venaflu bo shevarim af al pi shehaggemallim metzuyin sham tamid vahare hu poshea laggemallim hoil umechamat shehitlia naflu bo hashshevarim hare ze patur. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hammotze bor vechissahu vechazar vegillahu baal habbor chayyav veze haacharon patur. setamo beafar vechazar vehotzi et kol heafar ze haacharon chayyav shekkevan shessetamo beafar nistalleku maase harishon: 
Bor shel shene shuttafin veavar harishon velo kissahu hashsheni velo kissahu harishon chayyav ad sheyyimsor dilyo lashsheni. umishshemmasar dilyo lashsheni lidlot mimmennu niftar harishon venitchayyev hashsheni lechassoto. kissahu harishon uva hashsheni umetzao megulle velo kissahu hashsheni chayyav. vead ematay yihye hashsheni levaddo chayyav. ad sheyyeda harishon shehabbor megulle uchede sheyyiskor poalim veyichrot arazim vichassennu. vechol sheyyamut bo toch zeman ze hare hashsheni levaddo chayyav bo vechol sheyyamut bo achar zeman kaze shenehen chayyavin leshallem shehare shenehen pashu bo: 
Hammoser boro leshomer chayyav binzakav. veim mesaro lecheresh shote vekatan af al pi shehaya mechusse hare habbealim chayyavin shehabbor asuy lehitgallot veellu en bahen daat: 
Hamechasse boro bedilyo shel chavero uva baal haddeli venatal dilyo baal habbor chayyav: 
Echad hachofer bor o shiach o meara o charitz. velamma neemar <small>(Shemot 21 33)</small> "bor" ad sheyyihye bo kede lehamit. vechamma kede lehamit omek asara tefachim aval im haya pachot measara venafal letocho shor o shear behema chayya veof umet patur. veim huzzeku chayyav baal hattakkala nezek shalem: 
Haya omek habbor tisha umehen tefach echad mayim chayyav. shehattefach shel mayim chashuv keomek shene tefachim bayyabbasha. haya amok shemona umehen shene tefachim mayim o shehaya amko shiva umehen shelosha tefachim mayim venafal letocho shor vechayyotze bo umet en mechayyevin oto leshallem. veim tafas hannizzak en motziin miyyado shehaddevarim haellu yesh bahen safek: 
Hachofer bor amok asara tefachim uva acher vehishlimo leesrim uva acher vehishlimo lishloshim kullan chayyavim. chafar harishon pachot measara afillu tefach uva haacharon vehishlimo laasara ben shechafar bo tefach o shehigbiah binyan al sefato tefach ze haacharon chayyav. satam tefach shehosif o shessatar tefach shebbana hare ze safek im kevar nistallek maase rishon o adayin lo nistallek: 
Chafar harishon bor amok uva haacharon vehirchivo venafal letocho shor umet. im mechamat hevlo met haacharon patur shehare miet hevlo veim mechamat chavato met haacharon chayyav shehare hu hikriv hezzek bor ze. vechen im nafal hashshor meoto hatztzad shehirchiv haacharon haacharon chayyav shehare hikriv hezzek bor ze af al pi shemmet min hahevel. veim min hatztzad shechafar harishon nafal harishon chayyav shezze haacharon miet hevlo: 
Bor shechiyyeva alav hattora afillu lo meta habbehema ella mehevlo veen tzarich lomar im meta mechavato. lefichach im haya omek habbor kerachbo en lo hevel. veim lo nechbeta bo habbehema umeta patur. haya amko yeter al rachbo yesh lo hevel veim meta bo habbehema chayyav af al pi shello nechbeta bekarkaitah: 
Asa tel gavoah birshut harabbim venechbeta bo habbehema umeta. im haya gavoah asara tefachim chayyav leshallem. veim haya pachot measara patur al mitat habbehema. aval im huzzeka bilvad chayyav leshallem nezek shalem. vaafillu betel gavoah kol shehu o bachafira kol shehi. shehannezek bechol shehu davar matzuy veyadua veen hammita bechol shehu metzuya vahare hu kemo ones: 
Vechen eno chayyav al mitat habbehema bevor o al chavitatah betel. ella im hayita habbehema ketanna o chereshet o shota o suma o shennafla ballayla. aval im hayta pikkachat venafla bayyom umeta patur shezze kemo ones mippene shedderech habbehema lirot velasur min hammichsholot. vechen im nafal letocho adam umet afillu haya suma o shennafal ballayla ben shehaya ben chorin o eved hare ze patur. veim huzzak bo haadam o habbehema happikkachat chayyav nezek shalem kemo shebbearnu: 
Nafal letocho shor pesule hammukdashin umet hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 34)</small> "vehammet yihye lo" mi shehammet shello yatza ze shehu asur bahanaa vedino sheyyikkaver: 
Haya chofer babbor venafla habbehema betoch habbor mikkol hachafira umeta. im nafla millefaneha chayyav. meachareha kegon shennivata vechazra al akevah leachor venafla umeta patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 33)</small> "venafal" ad sheyyippol derech nefila. nafla lefaneha mikkol hachafira chutz labbor umeta en bet din mechayyevin oto. veim tafas hannizzak en motziin miyyado. veim nafla laachoreha chutz labbor umeta o huzzeka baal habbor patur: 
Shor sheddachaf behema letoch habbor umeta. im muad hu baal habbor meshallem mechetza uvaal hashshor mechetza. veim tam hu baal hashshor meshallem revia miggufo uvaal habbor meshallem shelosha chalakim min hayyafe shebbinchasav. shebbaal hannevela omer levaal habbor pechat nevela zo yesh li etzlecha af al pi shehi gedola ufikkachat kevan shennidchafa hare zo kemi shennafla ballayla kol sheani yachol lehotzi mibbaal hashshor ani motzi vehashshear atta chayyav leshallemo: 
Vechen hammanniach even al pi habbor uva hashshor venitkal bah venafal labbor umet. hammanniach et haeven meshallem mechetza uvaal habbor mechetza: 
Vechen shor shel hedyot veshel pesule hammukdashin shennagchu keechad. im tam hu ze shel hedyot meshallem chatzi nezek veim muad nezek shalem. shehannizak omer lo kol sheuchal lehotzi mizze otzi vehashshear mimmecha veze hoil vehekdesh hu ufatur atta teshallem li hakkol: 
Mi shehaya chofer bor birshut harabbim venafal alav shor vaharago. baal hashshor patur. veim met hashshor notel baal hashshor deme shoro miyyorshe baal habbor:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 13:
Kelim shennaflu labbor venishtabberu baal habbor patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 33)</small> "venafal shamma shor o chamor" mippi hashshemua lamdu shor velo adam chamor velo kelim. afillu nafal shor bechelav umet hashshor venishtabberu kelav chayyav al habbehema ufatur al hakkelim: 
Habbor meavot nezikin hu vetoldotav kamohu muadin mittechillatan. vechol hammanniach takkala hare zo toledet habbor veim huzzak bah adam o behema meshallem ze shehinniach hattakkala nezek shalem ben hifkir hattakkala ben lo hifkirah. veim huzzeku bah kelim patur: 
Ketzad. hammanniach avno o sakkino o tivno o massao vechayyotze bahen birshut harabbim vehuzzeku bahen ben adam ben behema chayyav nezek shalem. vechen im hinnichan birshuto vehifkir reshuto velo hifkiran nitkal bakkarka venechbat betakkala zo vehuzzak bah chayyav baal hattakkala. veim huzzeku kelim bechol ellu o nittannefu patur: 
Hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut vehirbitz gelalim venittannefu bahen kelav shel baal habbayit patur. shehaggalal ze toledet bor hu velo matzanu bor shechiyyev bo al hakkelim: 
Hammanniach et hakkad birshut harabbim vehalach [hamehallech] venitkal bah ushevarah patur lefi sheen derech bene adam lehitbonen badderech keshehen mehallechin. veim huzzak bah hare baal hakkad chayyav binzakav vaafillu hifkir hakkad. shekkol hammafkir nezakav bemakom sheen lo reshut laasotah mittechilla chayyav keillu lo hifkiran: 
Hinniach et hakkad bemakom sheyyesh lo reshut lehannichah sham kegon mekom hakkeranot shel gittot vechayyotze bahen venitkal bah ushevarah chayyav. veim huzzak bah hamehallech baal hakkad patur mippene shehaya lo lehistakkel. veim hayta afela o shemmille kol hadderech kaddim patur al sheviratah. veim nitkal bah hare baal hakkad chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Nishbera kaddo birshut harabbim vehuchlak echad bammayim o shellaka bacharaseha patur middine adam lefi sheanus hu. vechayyav bedine shamayim mippene shello sillek hacharasim. vahare hacharasim vehammayim kehefker velo hifkir ella achar shenneenas ulefichach patur. veim nitkavven lizkot bacharaseha vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav. vehu haddin lenafla gemallo velo heemidah vechol kayyotze bah. veim huzzeku kelim bechol ellu patur ben hifkir ben lo hifkir kemo shebbearnu: 
Shene kaddarin shehayu mehallechin badderech ze achar ze venitkal harishon venafal venitkal hashsheni barishon. im haya larishon laamod velo amad chayyav harishon benizke sheni sheaf al pi shehu anus bishat nefila eno anus bihyoto muttal badderech vahare hu yachol laamod. veim lo haya lo laamod patur veaf al pi shello hizhir laze shennitkal bo mippene shehu tarud benafsho: 
Bamme devarim amurim shehu chayyav binzakav shel sheni keshehuzzak gufo shel sheni. aval im huzzeku kelav patur sheeno chayyav al hakkelim babbor vechol takkala toledet bor hu kemo shebbearnu: 
Hakkadarim vehazzaggagim vechayyotze bahen shehayu mehallechin ze achar ze venitkal harishon venafal venitkal hashsheni barishon vehashshelishi bashsheni vechol echad mehen yesh lo laamod velo amad. harishon chayyav benizke gufo shel sheni ben shehuzzak begufo shel rishon hammuttal baaretz ben shehuzzak bemassao. vehashsheni chayyav benizke gufo shel shelishi im huzzak begufo shel sheni. aval im huzzak bemassao shel sheni shennafal patur. shehare omer lo hashsheni bor ze shehu massai en ani hakkore oto shehare harishon hippil hashsheni im massao. veim hizhiru ze et ze kullan peturin: 
Nafal harishon vehaya muttal lerochav hadderech venitkal echad berosho veechad beraglav veechad bevitno hare hu chayyav benizke kullan hoil vehaya lo laamod velo amad: 
Hashshofech et hammayim birshut harabbim vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav binzakav. veim nittanfu kelav patur kemo shebbearnu. nivleu hammayim baaretz venishara haaretz chalaka vehuchlak venafal vehuzzak bakkarka hare ze chayyav binzakav: 
Kol ellu sheppotkin bivotehen vegorfin mearotehen en lahen reshut lishpoch hammayim birshut harabbim bimot hachamma aval bimot haggeshamim yesh lahen reshut. veaf al pi chen im huzzak adam o behema bammayim chayyavin nezek shalem: 
Lo yotzi adam tivno vekashsho lirshut harabbim kede sheyyadushu veyaasu lo zevel. veim hotzi kenasuhu chachamim sheyyihyu kehefker vechol hakkodem bahen zacha meet shenniddoshu vehishbichu. veim kadam adam vezacha bahen mishsheat hotzaa lirshut harabbim en motziin miyyado. veaf al pi shehen kehefker im huzzak bahen adam o behema hare ze hammotzi chayyav leshallem: 
Yesh lechol adam lehotzi et hazzevel vehaggelalim lirshut harabbim bishat hotzaat zevalim velitzbor otan sham sheloshim yom kede sheyyihye nishshof beragle adam [veragle behema]. veaf al pi chen im hizzik chayyav leshallem. vechayyavin al ze haggalal mishshum gezel kevan sheen bo shevach im niddosh lo kansu bo: 
En shorin tit birshut harabbim veen lovnim levenim. aval govlin tit birshut harabbim aval lo levenim: 
Habbone birshut harabbim hammevi avanim mevi vehabbone bone. vechullan shehizziku chayyavin leshallem nezek shalem: 
Hachotzev shechatzav even umesarah lesattat vehuzzak bah adam o behema hassattat chayyav. vesattat shemmasar lechammar hachammar chayyav. masar chammar lechattaf hakkattaf chayyav. masar kattaf levone habbone chayyav. mesarah habbone leze shemmetakken yeshivatah babbinyan hametakken chayyav. veim achar sheheeluha al gabbe haddimos nafla vehizzika vehayu osin bekabbelanut kullan chayyavin. uvischirut haacharon chayyav vechullan peturin: 
Hakkotel vehailan shennaflu lirshut harabbim vehizziku patur milleshallem veaf al pi shehifkiran. lefi sheenan domim labbor shehare en techillatan lehazzik. veim hayu reuin bet din kovin lo zeman lakotz et hailan velistor et hakkotel. vechamma hazzeman sheloshim yom. naflu betoch hazzeman vehizziku patur leachar hazzeman chayyav mippene sheshshiha otan: 
Hammatznia et hakkotz veet hazzechuchit vehaggoder gedero bekotzim vehifriach lirshut harabbim vehuzzak echad bahen chayyav nezek shalem. veim gadar bekotzim betzimtzum betoch reshuto patur lefi sheen derech bene adam lehitchakkech bakketalim: 
Hammatznia kotzav uzechuchiyyotav betoch katlo shel chavero uva baal hakkotel vesatar et katlo venafal lirshut harabbim vehizzik. im kotel raua haya hammatznia chayyav. veim kotel bari hu baal hakkotel chayyav: 
Chasidim harishonim hayu matzniin et hakkotzim veet hazzechuchiyyot betoch sedotehem beomek shelosha tefachim baaretz kede shello taalem hammacharesha. vaacherim sorfim otan beesh. vaacherim mashlichim otan layyam o lannahar kede shello yuzzak bahen adam: 
Lo yesakkel adam mershuto lirshut harabbim. ven osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim velo borot velo shichin velo mearot veaf al pi shehaagala yechola lehallech al gabbehen vehi teuna avanim shemma tippachet millematta shello middato. vehachofer bor letzarche rabbim muttar: 
En motziin zizin ugezuzetraot lirshut harabbim ella im ken hayu lemala miggamal verochvo. vehu shello yaafil hadderech al bene reshut harabbim. veim ratza kones letoch shello umotzio. kanas velo hotzi hare ze motzi kol zeman sheyyirtze. aval eno yachol lehachezir ketalim limkoman leolam. shekkol metzar shehechziku bo rabbim asur lekalkelo: 
Lakach chatzer uvah zizin ugezuzteraot yotzot lirshut harabbim hare zo bechezkatah veim nafla chozer uvone otah keshehayta: 
Ilan shehu note lirshut harabbim kotzetz kede sheyyihye haggamal over berochvo. umannichin makom panuy mishshete siftot hannahar kerochav kitfe hammallachim sheyyordin sham umoshchin hassefina. vechol ilan hannimtza berochav ze kotztzin oto miyyad veen matrin bivalav shehare meakkev moshche hassefina: 
Mi shehayta derech harabbim overet betoch sadehu netalah unetanah lahem min hatztzad ma shennatan natan vezachu bo veze shennatal lo zacha bo. vechamma rochav derech harabbim en pachot mishshesh esre ammot:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 14:
Hammadlik betoch sede chaviro veavra haddeleka [vehizzika] chayyav leshallem nezek shalem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 5)</small> "ki tetze esh umatza kotzim veneechal gadish o hakkama" vegomer shallem yeshallem hammavir vegomer. vehabbeera meavot nezikin hi: 
Hidlik betoch reshuto tzarich leharechik missof hammetzar kede shello taavor haddeleka lisde chavero. vechamma shiur haharchaka hakkol lefi gova haddeleka. veim lo hirchik karauy veavra haesh vehizzika chayyav leshallem nezek shalem. hirchik karauy veavra vehizzika patur shezzo makka bide shamayim hi. vechen im avra nahar o shelulit sheyyesh bahen mayim verachban shemone ammot patur: 
Avra gader omdin gova haggader vegova haddeleka vehaetzim o hakkotzim hammetzuyin sham im enah reuya laavor patur veim reuya laavor chayyav. bamme devarim amurim beesh hakkodachat. aval im haya lah lahav gadol haole venichpaf miggova aliyyat hallahav vehayu etzim metzuyin sham en lah omed ella afillu avra elef amma chayyav: 
Nafla deleka bachatzero venafal gader shello mechamat haddeleka veavra haddeleka bechatzer acheret. im haya yachol ligdor haggader shennafal velo gedaro chayyav. lema haddavar dome leshoro sheyyatza vehizzik shehaya lo leshamro velo shemaro: 
Hashsholeach et habbeera beyad cheresh shote vekatan patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. bamme devarim amurim shemmasar lahen gachelet velibbuha shedderech haggachelet lehikkavot meeleha kodem shettaavor vetadlik. aval im masar lahen shalhevet chayyav shehare maasav garmu: 
Shalach et habbeera beyad pikkeach ze happikkeach shehivir chayyav leshallem vehashsholeach patur. vechen im hinniach shomer lishmor habbeera hashshomer chayyav: 
Echad hevi et haur veechad hevi et haetzim hammevi et haetzim chayyav. echad hevi et haetzim veechad hevi et haur hammevi et haur chayyav. ba acher velibbah hamelabbe chayyav. libbattu ruach sheenah metzuya tamid hare kullan peturin. libba velibbattu haruach chayyav shehare hu garam vechol haggorem lehazzik meshallem nezek shalem min hayyafe shebbannechasim kishar kol hammazzikin: 
Esh sheyyatza veachla etzim o avanim o afar chayyav leshallem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 5)</small> "umatza kotzim" kulei <small>(Shemot 22 5)</small> "o hassade". achla gadish vechayyotze bo vehayu kelim temunim betoch haggadish im hayu kegon morigim uchele bakar vechayyotze bahen middevarim shedderech anshe hassade letamnam baggadish chayyav leshallem. hayu begadim uchele zechuchit vechayyotze bahen patur al hakkelim: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemadlik betoch sede chavero. aval bemadlik betoch shello veavra lisde chavero patur al kol hakkelim hattemunim baggadish aval meshallem hu shiur mekom hakkelim veroin oto keillu hu male gadish shel chittim o shel seorim: 
Hammadlik betoch sede chavero veyatza haesh veneechal haggadish vehaya gedi kafut lo veeved samuch lo venisraf immo chayyav. shekken derech bene adam laasot begadish. haya eved kafut lo ugedi samuch lo venisraf immo patur: 
Hammashil makom lachavero vehigdish bo vehitmin bo kelim vehidlik hammashil vesaraf haggadish eno meshallem ella deme gadish bilvad. hishilo makom lehagedish chittim vehigdish seorim o lehagedish seorim vehigdish chittim o shehigdish chittim vechippam bisorim o shehigdish seorim vechippam bechittim eno meshallem lo ella deme seorim bilvad: 
Hammadlik et habbira shel chavero meshallem kol ma shebbetochah. shekken derech bene adam lehanniach kol kelehem vechol cheftzehem babbattim. vechol sheyyiton baal habbayit hare ze nishba binkitat chefetz venotel. ushevua zo middivre sofrim kemo sheyyitbaer. uvilvad sheyyiton devarim shehu amud bahen o shehu lamud lihyot otan haddevarim shettaan pikkadon etzlo: 
Gamal shehu taun pishtan veover birshut harabbim venichnas pishtano letoch hachanut vedalka benero shel chenvani vehidlik et kol habbira baal haggamal chayyav mippene shehirba bemassooy ben sheamda habbehema ben shello amda. hinniach hachenvani nero mibbachutz hachenvani chayyav af bidme pishtan mippene shehinniach nero mibbachutz. vaafillu ner chanukka haya lo leshev velishmor: 
Hakkofef kamato shel chavero lifne haesh ad shettidlak im en haesh maggaat lah ella beruach sheenah metzuya patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. vehattomen kamato shel chavero beafar o beteven veavra haesh veachla otah hare hattomen patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim mippene shehammadlik et haesh patur al hattamun: 
Esh sheavra vehizzika et haadam vechavla bo hare hammavir chayyav binzakav uveshivto uverippuyo uvetzaaro uvevashto keillu hizziko beyado. sheaf al pi sheishsho mamono hu hare hu kemo shehizzika bechitzav. aval im hizzika behemto o boro et haadam eno chayyav ella benezek bilvad kemo shebbearnu: 
Kol toldot haesh hare hen keesh. ketzad. hinniach even o sakkin o massa berosh gaggo venaflu beruach metzuya vehizziku chayyav leshallem nezek shalem shekkol ellu vechayyotze bahen toldot habbeera hen. veim naflu beruach sheenah metzuya vehizziku patur: seliku lehu hilchot nizke mamon besad
Mishneh Torah, Theft 1:
Kol haggonev mamon mishsheve peruta ulemala over al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 11)</small> "lo tignov". veen lokin al lav ze shehare nittan letashlumin shehaggannav chiyyevattu tora leshallem. veechad haggonev mamon yisrael o haggonev mamon akkum veechad haggonev et haggadol o et hakkatan: 
Asur lignov kol shehu din tora. veasur lignov derech sechok o lignov al menat lehachezir o al menat leshallem hakkol asur shello yargil atzmo bechach: 
Eze hu gannav ze hallokeach mamon adam basseter veen habbealim yodim. kegon happoshet yado letoch kis chavero velakach meotav veen habbealim roin. vechen kol kayyotze baze. aval im lakach begaluy uvefarhesya bechozek yad en ze gannav ella gazlan. lefichach listim mezuyyan shegganav eno gazlan ella gannav af al pi shehabbealim yodim beshaa shegganav: 
Gannav sheheidu alav edim kesherim shegganav chayyav leshallem shenayim levaal haggeneva. im ganav dinar meshallem shenayim. ganav chamor o kesut o gamal meshallem shenayim bedameha. nimtza mafsid kashshiur shebbikkesh lechasser et chavero: 
Gannav shehoda meatzmo shegganav meshallem et hakkeren ufatur min hakkefel shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 8)</small> "asher yarshiun elohim yeshallem shenayim" velo hammarshia et atzmo meshallem shenayim. vehu haddin lechol hakkenasot shehammode bahen patur: 
Tashlume kefel nohagin bakkol chutz misse veshor shehaggonev et hashshor o et hasse vetavach o machar meshallem al hasse tashlume arbaa veal hashshor tashlume chamishsha: 
Echad haish veechad haishsha shegganvu chayyavin leshallem tashlume kefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha. hayta eshet ish sheen lah leshallem hare hakkefel aleha chov ad shettitgaresh o yamut balah uvet din nifraim mimmenna: 
Katan shegganav patur min hakkefel umachzirin lo davar hagganuv mimmennu. veim avdu eno chayyav leshallem af hakkeren vaafillu leachar shehigdil: 
Haeved shegganav patur min hakkefel uvealav peturin sheen adam chayyav al nizke avadav af al pi shehen mamono mippene sheyyesh bahen daat veeno yachol leshamran sheim yachisennu rabbo yelech veyadlik gadish beelef dinar vechayyotze baze mishshear nezakin. nishtachrer haeved chayyav leshallem et hakkefel: 
Rauy levet din lehakkot et hakketannim kefi koach hakkatan al haggeneva kede shello yihyu regilin bah. vechen im hizziku shear nezakin. vechen makkin et haavadim shegganvu o shehizziku makka rabba kede shello yihyu regilin lehazzik: 
Hayta haggeneva beyad haggannav vehishbicha meeleha kegon kivsa sheyyalda ugezazah meshallem otah veet gizzoteha veet valdoteha. veim achar yeush yalda ugezazah meshallem kishat haggeneva. hotzi aleha hotzaa vehishbichah kegon sheppittemah hare hashshevach shel gannav afillu lifne yeush. ucheshemmachzir haggeneva im hakkefel notel hashshevach min habbealim o mechashshevin lo min hakkefel: 
Haggeneva atzmah shehi beyad haggannav velo nishtannet chozeret livaleha ben lifne yeush ben leachar yeush ella sheachar yeush hashshevach laggannav kemo shebbearnu. nishtannet haggeneva beyad haggannav kenaah vekana shivchah afillu lifne yeush veeno meshallem ella damim: 
Ganav kechusha vehishmina o shemena vehichchisha meshallem tashlume kefel o tashlume arbaa vachamishsha kishat haggeneva. ganav tale venaasa ayil egel venaasa shor meshallem tashlume kefel kishat haggeneva. tevacho o mecharo achar shehigdil naasa shinnuy beyado vekanahu veshello hu toveach veshello hu mocher veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha:

Lakach miggannav sheeno mefursam bemea umachar leacher bemea veesrim vehukkar haggannav. baal haggeneva noten leze haacharon mea veesrim venotel genevato vechozer habbaal venotel esrim shel sachar min hammocher venotel hammea min haggannav. veim gannav mefursam hu notel hammea veesrim min hattaggar shellakach min haggannav veholech hattaggar vetovea haggannav bemea shel keren. vehu haddin im machar hashsheni lishlishi vehashshelishi lirvii afillu mea shehu notel mikkol echad veechad ma shenniskar venotel hakkeren min haggannav. vechol haddevarim haellu lifne yeush kemo shebbearnu: 
Baal habbayit sheeno asuy limkor et kelav veyatza lo shem geneva bair vehikkir kelav usefarav beyad acherim. o shehaya asuy limkor vehayu kelim ellu shehikkir mikkelim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir. im bau edim shezze kelav shel ze yishshava ze shehen beyado binkitat chefetz bechamma lakach veyittol mibbaal habbayit veyachzir lo kelav: 
Haya baal habbayit asuy limkor et kelav velo hayu middevarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir af al pi sheyyatza lo shem geneva bair vehukkeru kelav eno machaziran miyyad hallakochot shemma hu mecharan laacherim. aval im bau bene adam velanu betoch beto veamad vezaak ballayla nignevu kelay usefaray uvau bene adam umatzu machteret chatura uvene adam shellanu betoch beto yotzin utzerorot shel kelim al kitfehem vehakkol omrim hallalu kelav usefarav shel peloni hare ze neeman. veyishshava ze shehakkelim beyado binkitat chefetz kamma hotzi veyittol mibbaal haggeneva veyachzir lo kelav: 
Ganav shehuchzak venitparsem shennichnas letoch bet chavero veedim meidim sheyyatza vechelim temunim lo tachat kenafav af al pi shehaya sham baal habbayit vetaan veamar lekuchin hen beyadi uvaal habbayit omer genuvim hem. im haya baal habbayit sheen darko limkor et kelav veotam kelim en derech bene adam lehateminan veen derech oto hammuchzak lehatzenia kelav tachat kenafav. hare baal habbayit neeman veyishshava binkitat chefetz venotel kelav. veim en adam ze muchzak bigneva en baal habbayit neeman ella nishba ze shehakkelim beyado shevuat hesset shehakkelim haellu lekuchim beyado veholech:
Mishneh Torah, Theft 6:
Kol davar shechezkato shehu ganuv asur likkach oto. vechen im rov oto haddavar shehu ganuv en lokchin oto. lefichach en lokchim min haroim tzemer o chalav o gedayim. aval lokchin mehen chalav ugevina bammidbar aval lo bayyishshuv. umuttar likkach min haroim arba tzon o arba gizzot shel tzemer meeder katan o chamesh meeder gadol. sheen chezkato shehu ganuv bedavar ze: 
Kelalo shel davar kol sheharoe mochro im haya baal habbayit margish bo muttar lelakcho min haroe. veim en baal habbayit margish bo asur lelakcho: 
En lokchin mishshomre perot etzim o perot ella bizman shehen yoshvin umochrim vehassallim vehappeles lifnehem. shehare haddavar galuy veyesh lo kol veen ze geneva. velokchin mippetach hagginna aval lo meachore hagginna. vechullan sheamru hatemen asur lakachat mehen. umuttar lakachat min haaris shehare yesh lo chelek bapperot uvaetzim: 
En lokchin min hannashim umin haavadim umin hakketannim ella devarim shechezkatan shehen shellahen middaat habbealim. kegon nashim shemmachru kele pishtan baggalil o agalim bashsharon. vechullan sheamru hatemen asur likkach mehen mippene shehen bechezkat geneva. velokchim betzim vetarnegolim bechol makom mikkol adam. veim amar hatemen asur: 
Lokchin min habbaddadin zetim bemidda veshemen bemidda aval lo zetim muatim velo shemen muat shechezkato geneva hem. vechen kol kayyotze bahem: 
Mochin shehakkoves motzi hare ellu shello veshehassorek motzi hare ellu shel baal habbayit. hakkoves notel shelosha chutin vehen shello yeter mikken shel baal habbayit. im haya shachor al gabbe lavan notel et hakkol vehem shello: 
Hachayyat sheshshiyyer min hachut kede meshichat machat veshiyyer min habbeged matlit shehi shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot chayyav lehacheziran labbealim. pachot mikkan shello: 
Nesoret shehecharash motzi. bemaatzad shello. bechashshil shel baal habbayit. veim haya ose etzel baal habbayit af hannesoret shel baal habbayit. vechol haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen holchin bahen achar minhag hammedina: 
Kol umman shemmachar davar min haddevarim sheeno shello kehilchot hammedina. kegon mochin shemmecharan hassorek bemakom shennahagu sheyyihyu shel baal habbayit. asur likkach mimmennu mippene shehen bechezkat geneva. aval lokchin mimmennu kar male mochin. veim machar haumman devarim shehen shello kehilchot medina lokchin mimmennu. veim amar hatemen asur:
Mishneh Torah, Theft 7:
Hashshokel lachavero mimmishkalot chaserot min hammishkal shehiskimu alav bene otah hammedina. o hammoded bemidda chasera min hammidda shehiskimu aleha. hare ze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 la)</small> "lo taasu avel bammishpat bammidda bammishkal uvammesura": 
Af al pi shehammoded o hashshokel chaser gonev eno meshallem lo tashlume kefel ella meshallem lo hammidda o hammishkal. veen lokin al lav ze mippene shehu chayyav betashlumin: 
Kol mi shemmashhe beveto o bachanuto midda chasera o mishkal chaser over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 13)</small> "lo yihye lecha bechischa" vegomer. vaafillu laasot hammidda avit shel meme raglayim asur. sheaf al pi sheen ze lokeach umocher bah shemma yavo mi sheeno yodea shehi chasera veyimdod bah. veen lokin al lav ze shehare en bo maase: 
Hayu hammiddot vehammishkalot shel bene hair chatumot bechotam yadua vezo hammidda o hammishkal hachaserim belo chotam. hare ze muttar lashhotam lishar tashmishe habbayit. kayyotze baze sela shennifgema min hatztzad lo yaasenna mishkal ben mishkelotav velo yizrekenna ben gerutotav velo yikkavenna veyitlenna betzavvar beno shemma yavo acher veyaasenna mishkal. ella o yishchok o yachtoch o yakotz o yashlich leyam hammelach: 
Chasra veamda al mechetza yekayyem. amda al pachot mimmechetza o al yeter mimmechetza yakotz ad sheyyaamidenna al mechetza. veim lo chasra ella pachot mishshetut yekayyem laset velatet bah aval lo lemishkal. shekkol pachot mishshetut rov bene adam mochalin bo bemassa uvemattan: 
Sela shennifgema baemtza asur lemachrah leharag o lecharam mippene shemmerammin bah et acherim. aval nokvah vetole otah betzavvar hakkatan: 
Ose adam middotav sea vachatzi sea verova sea. vekav vachatzi kav verova hakkav vachatzi harova usheminit harova. aval lo yaase kabbayim shello titchallef berova hassea shehu kav umechetza. vechen bemiddot hallach ose hin vachatzi hin ushelishit hahin ureviit hahin. velog vachatzi log ureviit usheminit veechad mishshemona bashsheminit. velo asru laasot shelishit hin ureviit hin af al pi shemmitchallefin ze baze hoil vehayu bammikdash mimot moshe rabbenu: 
Echad hannose vehannoten im yisrael o im akkum im madad o shakal bechaser over al lo taase vechayyav lehachezir. vechen asur lehateot et haakkum becheshbon ella yedakdek immo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 50)</small> "vechishshav im konehu" af al pi shehu kavush tachat yadecha. kal vachomer leakkum sheeno kavush tachat yadecha. vahare hu bichlal <small>(Devarim 25 16)</small> "ki toavat Adonai elohecha kol osho elle kol osho avel" mikkol makom: 
Vechen bemiddat hakkarka im hita et chavero bimshichat hakkarka over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 la)</small> "lo taasu avel bammishpat bammidda". bammidda zo middat hakkarka. vechen hu inyan pasuk ze lo taasu avel bammishpat lo bemishpat hammishkal velo bemishpat hammidda afillu midda ketanna kimsura: 
Bene chavura hammakpidim ze al ze shehechlifu chelek bechelek o lava mimmennu maachol vehechzir lo. ovrin mishshum midda umishshum mishkal umishshum minyan umishshum lovin uforin beyom tov: 
Hammassig gevul reehu vehichnis mittechum chavero betoch techumo afillu melo etzba. im bechazka asa hare ze gazlan. veim hissig basseter hare ze gannav. veim beeretz yisrael hissig haggevul hare ze over bishne lavin belav geneva o belav gezela uvelav <small>(Devarim 19 14)</small> "lo tassig". veen chayyav belav ze ella beeretz yisrael shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 14)</small> "benachalatcha asher tinchal": 
Kashe anshan shel middot yeter meanshan shel arayot shezze beno leven hammakom veze beno leven chavero. vechol hakkofer bemitzvat middot kechofer bitziat mitzrayim shehi techillat hatztziuuy. vechol hamekabbel alav mitzvat middot hare ze mode bitziat mitzrayim shehi garma lechol hatztziuuyin:
Mishneh Torah, Theft 8:
Mitzvat ase letzaddek hammoznayim vehammishkalot vehammiddot yafe yafe uledakdek becheshbonan bishat asiyyatan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 36)</small> "mozne tzedek" vegomer. vechen bemiddat hakkarka tzarich ledakdek becheshbon meshichat hakkarka al pi haikkarim hammitbaarim bechitve haggimatriyya. sheafilu melo etzba min hakkarka roin otah keillu hi melea karkom: 
Arba ammot hassemuchin lecharitz mezalzelin bimshichatan vehassemuchim lisfat hannahar en moshchin otan kelal mippene shehen shel bene reshut harabbim: 
Vehammoded et hakkarka lo yamod leechad bimot hachamma uleechad bimot haggeshamim mippene shehachevel mitkatztzer bimot hachamma. lefichach im madad bekane o beshalshelet shel barzel vechayyotze bahem en bechach kelum: 
En osin mishkalot lo shel barzel velo shel oferet velo shel shear mine mattachot kaellu mippene shemmaalin chaluda umitchasserin. aval osin shel tzechiach sela veshel zechuchit veshel even shoham vechayyotze bahen: 
En osin et hammachak lo shel delaat mippene shehu mekel velo shel mattechet mippene shehu machbid. aval osehu shel zayit veshel egozim veshel shikma veshel eshkeroa vechayyotze bahen: 
En osin et hammachak tziddo echad katzar vetziddo echad ave. velo yimchok meat meat mippene shemmafchito lammocher. velo yimchok bevat achat mippene shemmafchito lallokeach: 
En tomnin et hammishkalot bemelach kede sheyyifchatu. velo yartiach bemiddat hallach beet shemmoded. vaafillu hayta hammidda ketanna beyoter. shehare hattora hikpida al hammiddot bechol shehu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 la)</small> "uvammesura" vehi midda achat ketanna mishsheloshim ushelosha belog: 
Mochre ashashiyyot shel barzel vechayyotze bahen tzarich lihyot chute hammoznayim sheochez hashshokel beyado taluy baavir shelosha tefachim ugevohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim veorech kene hammoznayim veorech hachutim shenem asar tefach: 
Moznayim shel mochre tzemer veshel mochre zechuchit yihye orech hachutim shehen teluyin bo shene tefachim ugevohin min haaretz shene tefachim vehakkane vehachutin arkan tisha tefachim: 
Moznayim shel chenvani veshel baal habbayit yihye orech hachut shehen teluyim bo tefach ugevohin min haaretz tefach vehakkane vehachutin arkan shishsha tefachim: 
Hachut shettolin bo happeles vechen chut moznayim shel zahav veshel mochre argaman tov arko shalosh etzbaot ugevohin min haaretz shalosh etzbaot veorech happeles veorech hashshalshelaot shello kefi ma shehu rotze: 
Minnayin shechayyav hammocher lehacheria lallokeach beet sheshshokel lo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 15)</small> "even shelema vatzedek yihye lach" amra tora tzaddek mishshellecha veten lo: 
Vechamma belach echad lemea uveyavesh echad learba meot. ketzad. machar lo eser litra lach noten lo gerumin echad measara belitra. veim machar lo esrim litrin yavesh noten lo gerumav echad meesrim belitra. vechen lefi cheshbon ze ben rav ben meat: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemakom shennahagu limkor ayin beayin. aval bemakom shennahagu lehacheria chayyav lehacheria lo tefach: 
Haya shokel lo eser litrin lo yomar lo shekol achat achat vehachera ella shokel lo asara bevat achat vehechrea echad lechullan: 
Makom shennahagu lamod bedakka lo yamod begassa. begassa lo yamod bedakka. limchok lo yigdosh veyosif bedamim. vechen im nahagu ligdosh lo yimchok veyifchot min haddamim. ella moded keminhag hammedina: 
Bene medina sheratzu lehosif al hammiddot o al hammishkalot lo yosifu yeter al shetut. sheim haya hakkav mechil chamishsha vaasauhu mechil shishsha harshut beyadan. yeter al shishsha lo yaasu: 
Hassiton mekanneach et middotav achat lishloshim yom. uvaal habbayit achat lishnem asar chodesh. vehachenvani mekannechan paamayim beshabbat. umemache mishkelotav paam achat beshabbat umekanneach moznayim al kol mishkal umishkal kede shello yachlidu: 
Hamevakkesh lishkol shelosha revie litra noten litra bechaf moznayim vehabbasar urevia litra bechaf sheniyya sheim atta omer noten chatzi litra urevia litra bechaf achat shemma yippol revia hallitra veen hallokeach roehu: 
Chayyavin bet din lehaamid shotrim bechol medina umedina uvechol pelech ufelech sheyyihyu mechazzerin al hachanuyyot umetzaddekin et hammoznayim veet hammiddot ufoskin hashshearim. vechol mi shennimtza immo mishkal chaser o midda chasera o moznayim mekulkalin yesh lahem reshut lehakkoto kefi kocho ulekanso kefi reot bet din lechazzek haddavar. vechol mi shemmafkia et hashshaar umocher beyoker makkin oto vechofin oto umocher keshaar hashshuk:
Mishneh Torah, Theft 9:
Kol haggonev nefesh adam over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 13)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 16)</small> "lo tignov". pasuk ze haamur baaseret haddevarim hi azhara legonev nefashot. vechen hammochro over belo taase shezze bichlal <small>(Vayikra 25 42)</small> "lo yimmachru mimkeret aved". veen lokin al shene lavin ellu mippene shehu lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 7)</small> "ki yimmatze ish gonev nefesh meechav" vegomer umitato bechenek: 
En haggannav chayyav mitat chenek ad sheyyignov et hayyisrael veyachnisenu lirshuto veyishtammesh bo veyimkerennu laacherim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 7)</small> "vehitammer bo umecharo". vaafillu lo nishtammesh bo ella befachot mishsheve peruta kegon shennishan alav o nismach bo af al pi shehannignav yashen hare ze nishtammesh bo: 
Genavo venishtammesh bo umecharo vaadayin hagganuv birshut atzmo velo hichniso haggannav lirshuto patur. genavo vehotzio lirshuto venishtammesh bo velo mecharo o mecharo kodem shennishtammesh bo o nishtammesh bo umecharo leechad mikkerovav shel ganuv kegon shemmecharo leaviv o leachiv hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 7)</small> "gonev nefesh meechav" ad sheyyavdilennu meechav umikkerovav bammechira. vechen im genavo vehu yashen venishtammesh bo keshehu yashen umecharo vaadayin hu yashen hare ze patur: 
Vechen im ganav ishsha umecharah leubbareha bilvad kegon shehitna al hallokeach shezzo hashshifcha li veen lecha ella havveladot hare ze patur: 
Haggonev et beno o et achiv hakkatan vechen haappotroppin shegganvu et hayetomim shehen semuchin etzlam uvaal habbayit shegganav echad mibbene beto hassemuchin al shulchano umelammed tinokot shegganav echad min hakketannim hallomdim etzlo. af al pi shennishtammesh bo umecharo patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 16)</small> "venimtza veyado" perat leellu shehen metzuyin beyadam: 
Echad haggonev et haggadol o haggonev et hakkatan ben yomo shekkalu lo chodashav ben zachar ben nekeva ben shehaya haggannav ish o ishsha hare ellu neheragin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 7)</small> "gonev nefesh" mikkol makom. veechad haggonev et yisrael o shegganav ger o eved meshuchrar shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 7)</small> "nefesh meechav" veellu bichlal achenu hen betora uvemitzvot. aval haggonev et haeved o mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin patur: 
Habba bammachteret ben bayyom ben ballayla en lo damim ella im harago baal habbayit o shear haadam peturin. ureshut yesh lakkol lehargo ben bechol ben beshabbat bechol mita sheyyecholin lahamito shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 1)</small> "en lo damim": 
Veechad habba bammachteret o gannav shennimtza betoch gaggo shel adam o betoch chatzero o betoch karpifo ben bayyom ben ballayla. velamma neemar <small>(Shemot 22 1)</small> "machteret" lefi shedderech rov haggannavim lavo bammachteret ballayla: 
Umippene ma hittira tora damo shel ganav af al pi shebba al iske mamon. lefi shechezkato sheim amad baal habbayit lefanav umenao yahargenu venimtza ze hannichnas levet chavero lignov kerodef achar chavero lehargo. ulefichach yaharog ben shehaya gadol ben shehaya katan ben zachar ben nekeva: 
Haya haddavar barur levaal habbayit shezze haggannav habba alav eno horgo velo ba ella al iske mamon asur lehargo veim harago hare ze horeg nefesh. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 2)</small> "im zarcha hashshemesh alav" im barur lecha haddavar kashemesh sheyyesh lo shalom immecha el tahargehu. lefichach av habba bammachteret al beno eno neherag shevvadday sheeno horgo. aval habben habba al aviv neherag: 
Vechen haggannav shegganav veyatza. o shello ganav umetzao yotze min hammachteret hoil ufana oref veeno rodef yesh lo damim. vechen im hikkifuhu bene adam o edim af al pi sheadayin hu birshut ze shebba alav eno neherag. veen tzarich lomar im ba levet din sheeno neherag: 
Vechen habba bammachteret letoch ginnato o letoch sadehu o letoch haddir vehassahar yesh lo damim. shechezkato shebba al hammamon bilvad lefi sheen rov habbealim metzuyim bimkomot ellu: 
Kol gannav sheyyesh lo damim im nafal alav gal beshabbat mefakkechim alav. veim shavar kelim beviato chayyav betashlumin. aval mi sheen lo damim sheshshavar kelim beviato patur kemo shebbearnu: seliku lehu hilchot geneva besad
Mishneh Torah, Robbery and Lost Property: Kol haggozel et chavero sheve peruta over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 13)</small> "lo tigzl". en lokin al lav ze shehare hakkatuv nitteko laase sheim gazal chayyav lehachezir shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 23)</small> "veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal" zo mitzvat ase. vaafillu saraf haggezela eno loke shehare hu chayyav leshallem dameha vechol lav shennittan letashlumin en lokin alav:
Veasur ligzol kol shehu din tora afillu akkum asur legazlo o leashko. veim gezalo o ashako yachzir:

E zehu gozel ze hallokeach mamon haadam bechazka kegon shechataf miyyado mittaltelin o shennichnas lirshuto shello birtzon habbealim venatal mishsham kelim. o shettakaf beavdo uvivhemto venishtammesh bahen. o sheyyarad letoch sadehu veachal peroteha vechol kayyotze baze hu gozel. kainyan shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 23 21)</small> "vayyigzl et hachanit miyyad hammitzri":

E zehu oshek ze shebba mamon chavero letoch yado birtzon habbealim vechevan shettevauhu kavash hammamon etzlo bechazka velo hecheziro. kegon shehaya lo beyad chavero halevaa o sechirut vehu tovo veeno yachol lehotzi mimmennu mippene shehu allam vekashe. veal ze neemar <small>(Vayikra 19 13)</small> "lo taashok et reacha":

Kol haggozel chayyav lehachezir haggezela atzmah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 23)</small> "veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal". veim avda o nishtannet meshallem dameha. ben shehoda mippi atzmo ben shebbau alav edim sheggazal hare ze chayyav leshallem hakkeren bilvad. afillu gazal kora uvenaah babbira hoil velo nishtannet din tora hu sheyyaharos et kol habbinyan veyachzir kora livaleha. aval tikkenu chachamim mippene takkanat hashshavim sheyyihye noten et dameha velo yafsid habbinyan. vechen kol kayyotze baze. afillu gazal kora vaasaah besukkat hechag uva baal hakkora letavah betoch hechag noten lo et dameha. aval achar hechag hoil velo nishtannet velo benaah betit machzir et hakkora atzmah:

Haggozel pachot mishsheve peruta af al pi sheavar eno betorat hashavat gezela. gazal shalosh aguddot shavot shalosh perutot vehuzzelu vahare shelashtan shavot shete perutot vehechzir lo shetayim chayyav lehachezir hashshelishit hoil uvattechilla hayta shava peruta. gazal shetayim shevot peruta vehechzir achat gezela en kan mitzvat hashavat gezela en kan:

Haggozel et chavero bayyishshuv vehechzir lo gezelato bammidbar harshut beyad hannigzal im ratza notel veim lav omer lo eni notel ella bayyishshuv shemma teanes mimmenni kan. vahare hi birshut haggazlan uveacharayuto ad sheyyachazirennah lo bayyishshuv. vechen bidme haggezela:

Haggozel et chavero vehivlia lo becheshbon yatza. veim hechzir lechiso sheyyesh bo maot yatza sheadam asuy lemashmesh bechiso bechol shaa vahare mana hammaot shehechzir lo bichlal meotav uminyan shello middaat poter. veim hechzir lechis sheen bo kelum lo yatza vechayyav beacharayut haggezela ad sheyyodio shehechzir lechis peloni:

Kol hachomed avdo o amato o beto vechelav shel chavero o davar sheefshar lo sheyyiknehu mimmennu vehichbir alav bereim vehiftzir bo ad shellekacho mimmennu af al pi shennatan lo damim rabbim hare ze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 14)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 18)</small> "lo tachmod". veen lokin al lav ze mippene sheen bo maase. veeno over belav ze ad sheyyikkach hachefetz shechamad. kainyan shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 25)</small> "lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem velakachta lach". chimmud sheyyesh bo maase:

Kol hammitavve beto o ishto vechelav shel chavero. vechen kol kayyotze bahen mishshear devarim sheefshar lo liknotan mimmennu. kevan shechashav belibbo heach yikne davar ze venifta belibbo baddavar avar belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 5 18)</small> "lo titavve" veen taava ella ballev bilvad:

Hattaava mevia lide chimmud vehachimmud mevi lide gezel. sheim lo ratzu habbealim limkor af al pi shehirba lahem bedamim vehiftzir bereim yavo lide gezel shenneemar <small>(Micha 2 2)</small> "vechamdu battim vegazalu". veim amdu habbealim befanav lehatztzil mamonam o menauhu milligzol yavo lide shefichut damim. tze ulemad mimmaase achav venavot:

Ha lamadta shehammitavve over belav echad vehakkone davar shehitavva beheftzer shehiftzir babbealim o bevakkasha mehen over bishne lavin. lechach neemar <small>(Shemot 20 14)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 18)</small> "lo tachmod" v<small>(Devarim 5 18)</small> "lo titavve". veim gazal avar bishlosha lavin:

Kol haggozel et chavero sheve peruta keillu notel nishmato mimmennu shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 1 19)</small> "ken archot kol botzea batza et nefesh" vegomer. veaf al pi chen im lo hayta haggezela kayyemet veratza haggazlan laasot teshuva uva meelav vehechzir deme haggezela. takkanat chachamim hi sheen mekabbelin mimmennu ella ozrin oto umochalin lo kede lekarev hadderech hayeshara al hashshavim. vechol hamekabbel mimmennu deme haggezela en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu:

Haggezela shello nishtannet ella hare hi kemo shehayta af al pi shennityaashu habbealim mimmenna veaf al pi shemmet haggazlan vahare hi beyad banav hare zo chozeret livaleha beatzmah. veim nishtannet beyad haggazlan af al pi sheadayin lo nityaashu habbealim mimmenna kenaah beshinnuy umeshallem dameha kishat haggezela:

Vedin ze din tora hu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 23)</small> "veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal". mippi hashshemua lamdu im hi kesheggezalah meshallem otah veim nishtannet beyado meshallem dameha. nityaashu habbealim mimmenna velo nishtannet kana haggazlan kol hashshevach shehishbicha achar yeush veeno meshallem ella kishat haggezela. vedavar ze middivrehem mippene takkanat hashshavim. ucheshemmachzir lo haggezela shamin lo hashshevach venotel min hannigzal:

Mecharah haggazlan o netanah bemattana af al pi shello nishtannet haggezela enah chozeret beatzmah miyyad hallokeach hoil venityaashu habbealim ben lifne mechira unetina ben leachar mechira unetina kenaah hallokeach beyeush veshinnuy reshut:

Haggozel vehishbiach umachar o horish lifne yeush ma shehishbiach horish uma shehishbiach machar vekana lokeach o yoresh et hashshevach. venotel deme hashshevach min hannigzal umachazir lo haggezela. vechozer hannigzal venotel deme hashshevach min haggazlan shehare lo nityaesh. vechen im hishbiach hallokeach o hayyoresh notel hashshevach min hannigzal:

Machar haggazlan leakkum af al pi shehishbiach haakkum chozeret livaleha. mecharah haakkum leyisrael achar shehishbiach hoil vehaggazlan yisrael veze shehi beyado yisrael kana hashshevach. veim tafas hannigzal en motziin miyyado:

Kevar bearnu shehaggezela shehishbicha achar yeush o achar shennishtannet hashshevach laggazlan mippene takkanat hashshavim af al pi shehishbicha meeleha. ketzad. gazal para venitabbera etzlo ben sheyyalda kodem shettevao bedin ben sheadayin lo yalda. gazal rachel venitana etzlo ben sheggezazah kodem shettevao baddin ben sheadayin lo gezazah. hoil venityaashu habbealim meshallem kishat haggezela. veim yalda ugezazah haggizzot vehavveladot shel gazlan. veim adayin lo yalda velo gezazah shamin lo venotel hashshevach min hannigzal umachazir habbehema atzmah:

Gazal para meubberet venityaashu habbealim veachar kach yalda. rachel teuna venityaashu habbealim veachar kach gezazah. meshallem deme para haomedet leled udeme rachel haomedet liggazez. veim lifne yeush o kodem shennishtanna yalda o gezazah hare haggizzot vehavveladot shel bealim. veaf al pi shennitabbera o nitana beyad haggazlan hoil velo nityaashu habbealim velo nishtannet haggezela. birshut bealeha hi adayin af al pi shehaggazlan chayyav boonaseha:

Ganav o gazal vehikdish vetavach achar shennityaashu habbealim hare hi birshut haggazlan mishshaa shehikdishah bilvad kede shello yehe chote niskar. vechol valdoteha vegizzoteha mishsheat geneva ad sheat hekdesh shel bealim:

Bamme devarim amurim beshevach habba meelav kegon gizzot uveladot. aval im hayta kechusha ufittemah afillu lifne yeush notel min hannigzal shevach happittum. vechen kol kayyotze baze mishshevach sheyyesh bo hotzaa:
Shinnuy hachozer livriyyato eno shinnuy. ketzad. haggozel etzim vedibbekan bemasmerim veasa mehen teva eno shinnuy shehare efshar lefarkan vechozrin luchot keshehayu:

Gazal afar vaasaahu levena lo kana sheim yadok hallevena tachzor afar keshehayta. gazal lashon shel mattechet vaasaahu matbea lo kana sheim yattich hammatbea yachzor lashon keshehayta. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Aval haggozel etzim userafan vekitztzetzan o chakak bahen vaasaan kelim. o sheggazal tzemer utzevao o nippetzo velibbeno. o sheggazal tavuy veasahu beged. o sheggazal levena vaasaah afar o avanim vesittetan o maot vehittichan. hare ze shinnuy beyado sheim yaasem maot acherot panim chadashot hen. vechen kol kayyotze bahen:

Haggozel maot yeshanot veshafan vechiddeshan lo kana shehare mityashshenin vechozrin keshehayu. gazal maot chadashim veyishshenam kana sheim yechaddeshem panim chadashot hen. gazal dekel mechubbar vekitztzetzo lo kana vaafillu kerato chulyot chulyot. asahu korot kana:

Gazal korot gedolot vaasaan ketannot lo kana. asaan luchot ad shennishtanna shemam kana. gazal lulav vehifrid alav kana healim. gazal alim vaasaan chuppiyay kana. gazal tale venaasa ayil egel venaasa shor hare ze shinnuy beyado vekanahu umeshallem kishat haggezela. veaf al pi shello nityaashu habbealim:

Gazal keli ushevaro en shamin lo happechat ella meshallem damav vehakkeli hashshavur shel gazlan. veim ratzu habbealim littol hakkeli hashshavur notlin umeshallem happechat. shezzo takkana hi labbealim veim lo ratzu harshut beyadan. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Gezela shello nishtannet vehukera af al pi shennityaashu habbealim mimmenna hare zo chozeret labbealim veen laggazlan bah kelum. shello tikkenu laggazlan et hashshevach achar yeush ella kegon gizzot uveladot. aval shevach hayyoker im hayta haggezela chozeret beeneha eno zoche bah:

Haggozel chavit shel yayin mechavero vahare hi shava dinar bishat haggezela vehukera etzlo veamda bearbaa. im shavar hechavit o shata otah o mecharah o netanah bemattana achar shehukera meshallem arbaa kishat hotzaa min haolam sheillu hinnichah hayta chozeret beatzmah. nishbera meeleha o avda meshallem dinar kishat haggezela: 
Hayta shava bishat haggezela arbaa uvishat hotzaa min haolam dinar. meshallem arbaa kishat haggezela. ben sheshshevarah o shetaah ben shennishbera o avda meeleha. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haggozel chotel sheyyesh bo chamishshim temarim uchesheyyimkor hachotel kullo keachat yimkor betisha uchesheyyimkor achat achat yimkor baasara. eno meshallem ella tisha. veen hannigzal yachol lomar lo ani achat achat hayiti mocher. vechen haddin bemazzik. vechen kol kayyotze baze benichse hedyot. aval behekdesh eno ken ella meshallem asara: 
Gazal behema vehizkina o kachasha kachash sheeno yachol lachzor kegon cholaim sheen lahem refuat teala. o sheggazal matbea venisdak o pesalo hammelech. o sheggazal perot vehirkivu kullan. o sheggazal yayin vehechmitz. hare ze kemi sheggazal keli ushevaro umeshallem kishat haggezela. aval im gazal behemot vechachashu kachash sheefshar lachzor. o sheggazal avadim vehizkinu. o sheggazal matbea venifsal bimdina zo vahare hi yotze bimdina acheret. o sheggazal perot vehirkivu miktzatam. o teruma venitmet. o sheggazal chametz veavar alav happesach. o behema veneevda bah avera. o nifsela millikkarev. o shehayta yotza lehissakel. omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha umachazir otah beatzmah: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehechezir haggezela. aval im nisrefa haggezela o avda achar shenneesra bahanaa chayyav lehachezir lo dameha kishat haggezela. lefichach im kafar bo achar shenneesra bahanaa venishba chayyav leshallem keren vechomesh veasham: 
Haggozel behema venasa aleha massa o rachav aleha o charash o dash bah vechayyotze baze vehechzir livaleha af al pi sheavar belo taase eno chayyav leshallem kelum shehare lo hifsidah velo hichchishah. veim huchzak adam ze ligzol o laashok o laasot maasim ellu paam achar paam konsin oto vaafillu bechutza laaretz. veshamin hassachar o hashshevach shehishbiach babbehema umeshallem lannigzal: 
Hattokef avdo shel chavero veasa bo melacha velo bittelo mimmelacha acheret patur shennoach lo laadam shello yibbatel avdo. veim bittelo mimmelacha acheret meshallem lo kefoel: 
Hattokef sefinato shel chavero veasa bah melacha im enah asuya lesachar shamin kamma pachata umeshallem. veim hi asuya lesachar im yarad lah betorat sechirut hoil veyarad shello birshut im ratza habbaal littol secharah notel ratza littol pechatah notel. veim yarad lah betorat gezel noten happechat. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato. im otah chatzer enah asuya lesachar eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. af al pi shedderech ze haddar liskor makom leatzmo. shezze nehene veze eno chaser. veim hechatzer asuya lesachar af al pi sheen derech ze liskor tzarich lehaalot lo sachar shehare chissero mamon: 
Mi shehaya lo tzemer vesammanim sheruyin uva echad vetzava hatztzemer bassammanin shello middaat chavero. meshallem lo deme ma shehifsid batztzemer veeno mechashshev lo shevach sammanin sheal gabbe hatztzemer. veim tafas hannizzak deme ma shechasru min hassammanin en motziin miyyado: 
Hashsholeach yad befikkadon ben sheshshalach yad beatzmo o al yad beno veavdo ushelucho hare ze gazlan venitchayyev beonasav. venaaset haggezela birshuto kedin kol haggazlanim. chashav lishloach yad befikkadon eno chayyav beacharayuto ad sheyyishlach yad. umishsheshalach yad nitchayyev bo. af al pi shello chasar mimmennu kelum ella natal happikkadon mimmakom lemakom birshuto kede lishloach bo yad hare ze chayyav sheshshelichut yad enah tzericha chissaron: 
Higbiah et hechavit littol mimmenna reviit nitchayyev boonaseha af al pi shello natal. aval im higbiah et hakkis littol mimmennu dinar vechayyotze bakkis middevarim sheenan guf echad hare ze safek im nitchayyev bechol hakkis o lo nitchayyev ella bedinar bilvad: 
Hayu perot mufkadin etzlo venatal miktzatan eno chayyav ella beacharayut happerot shennatal ushear happikkadon hammunnach bimkomo birshut bealav hu. veim nifsad hashshear mechamat ze shennatal chayyav bakkol. ketzad. hitta et hechavit bimkomah venatal mimmenna reviit o yeter im nishbera achar shennatal vehi bimkomah eno chayyav ella kamma shennatal shehare lo higbiah hechavit. veim hechmitza meshallem et deme kullah kishat haggezela. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hakkofer befikkadon bevet din. im haya birshuto bishat shekkafar naasa alav gazlan vechayyav beanso: 
Hashshoel shello middaat habbealim hare ze gazlan. haya keli beyad beno shel baal habbayit o beyad avdo ulekacho echad mehen venishtammesh bo hare ze shoel shello middaat venaasa birshuto venitchayyev boonasav ad sheyyachzirenu labbealim. lefichach im hecheziro lekatan shehaya beyado o leeved veavad mehen o nishbar chayyav leshallem. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hachotef mashkon miyyad hallo shello birshut bet din hare ze gazlan af al pi shehu chayyav lo. veen tzarich lomar im nichnas letoch bet chavero umishkeno shehu gazlan shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 11)</small> "bachutz taamod":

Kennas kansu chachamim laggazlanin sheyyihye hannigzal nishba al kol ma sheyyiton venotel min haggazlan. vehu sheyyihye ze muchzak sheggezalo bishne edim: 
Ketzad. hare shennichnas letoch bet chavero lemashkeno bifne edim velo haya kelum tachat kenafav veyatza vechelim muttalin lo tachat kenafav velo yadu haedim ma hen uvaal habbayit omer kach vechach gezaltani. ben sheamar haggazlan meolam lo nichnasti velo natalti kelum. ben sheamar nichnasti lemashken kemo sherau haedim aval lo natalti velo haya tachat kenafay ella kelim shelli. ben sheamar natalti keli ze uvaal habbayit toen shennatal ze ucheli acher. hare baal habbayit nishba binkitat chefetz venotel kol ma sheyyiton: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshettaan devarim shehu amud bahen o shehu amud shemmafkidin etzlo otan devarim shettaan vetaan bidvarim sheefshar sheyyinnatlu tachat hakkenafayim kemo sheheidu haedim: 
Rauhu edim shennichnas lemashken et chavero velo rauhu beet sheyyatza o sheyyatza veen nire tachat kenafav kelum uvaal habbayit toen veomer kach vechach natal. afillu omer meolam lo nichnasti shehare machchish et haedim hare ze patur. sheim amar nichnasti velo natalti nishba shevuat hesset shello natal kelum veholech. sheefshar sheyyikkanes ligzol velo gazal: 
Haya ed echad meido shennichnas venatal kelim tachat kenafav veeno yodea ma hen. vehu omer lo gazalti kelum o sheamar bechovi natalti. hoil veen haed yodea me haya tachat kenafav hare ze nishba binkitat chefetz shello gazal. sheeno muchzak begazlanut ella bishne edim: 
Keshem shebbaal habbayit nishba venotel min haggazlan kach shomer shel baal habbayit afillu ishto shel shomer nishbaat shezze natal kach vechach umeshallem haggazlan: 
Haya sham lekito o sechiro shel baal habbayit enan nishbain venotlin. veen hannigzal yachol lishshava shehare lo haya beveto beshaa shennigzal veen haedim yodim ma natal tachat kenafav kede lechayyev haggazlan lehachezir. veen mashbiin et haggazlan mippene shehu chashud al hashshevua: 
Vechetzad osim bedin ze. macharim baal habbayit cherem setam al mi shennatal mibbeto kelum veeno mode bevet din. vaafillu hoda haggazlan sheggazal ketzat machzir hammiktzat shehoda bah bilvad shehare en baal habbayit toano taanat vadday: 
Haggozel echad mechamishsha veen yadua mi hu hannigzal vechol echad veechad mehen tovo veomer li gazalta af al pi sheen sham edim sheggazal hare kol echad mehen nishba shezze gezalo umeshallem gezela lechol echad veechad. af davar ze kenas hu shekkenasuhu chachamim mippene sheavar avera vegazal. aval din tora eno chayyav leshallem missafek: 
Amar lishnayim gazalti echad mikkem o aviv shel echad mikkem veeni yodea ezehu. im ba latzet yede shamayim chayyav leshallem gezela lechol echad veechad. aval bedin eno noten ella gezela achat vehen cholkin otah benehen. shehare en echad mehen yodea shennigzal ella ze ba vehodiam. velo kansu chachamim bedavar ze mippene sheen lo tovea: 
Hattoen et chavero veamar lo gezaltani mea. im amar lo gazalti nishba shevuat hesset kedin kol nitba. veim hoda sheggezalo chamishshim meshallem chamishshim venishba shevuat hattora al hashshear kedin kol mode bemiktzat shehare lo huchzak gazlan beedim. vechen hattoen et chavero shennichnas leveto ugezalo kelim vehu omer derech mashkon lakachti bechov sheyyesh li etzlecha uvaal habbayit omer en lecha beyadi kelum af al pi shehoda shemmishkeno shello birshut hoil veen sham edim shemmeidim sheggazal hare ze nishba vegove chovo min hammashkon shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. vehoil vehu nishba venotel hare ze nishba binkitat chefetz kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot toen: 
Rauhu edim shennichnas letoch bet chavero shello bifne baal habbayit venatal mishsham kelim. af al pi shehotzian megullin veaf al pi shebbaal habbayit hazze asuy limkor et kelav. im taan veamar derech gezel lekachan vehalla omer birshutecha bati veatta mechartam li o netattam li o bechov sheyyesh li etzlecha tefastim eno neeman. shekkol hannichnas levet chavero shello befanav venatal kelim mishsham vehotzian bifne edim hare ze bechezkat gazlan. lefichach machzir hakkelim levaal habbayit veen kan shevua shehare haedim rau ma gazal. veachar sheyyachzir chozer vetovea et baal habbayit bechol ma sheyyiton vehaddin benehen: 
Vechen im haya sham ed echad bilvad uvaal habbayit toen sheggazul hu keli ze beyado vehalla omer lakuach hu beyadi o bechov gevitiv o shelli haya ufikkadon hu etzlecha hare ze chayyav lehachezir hakkeli livalav belo shevua sheillu hayu sham shene edim haya chayyav leshallem veachshav sheen sham ella ed echad chayyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava shehare eno machchish et haed vechol hamechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava meshallem. lefichach im kafar veamar lo nichnasti leveto velo natalti kelum hoil veen sham ella ed echad vehu machchisho hare ze nishba shevuat hattora shello lakach mibbeto kelum veniftar: 
Maase beechad shechataf lashon shel kesef miyyad chavero bifne ed echad. uva hachotef veamar chatafti veshelli chatafti. vechiyyevuhu chachamim lehachezir mippene shehu mechuyyav shevua beed ze veeno yachol lishshava shehare hoda kemo sheamar haed. veillu lo haya sham ed kelal haya nishba shevuat hesset sheshshello chataf. veillu hichchish haed veamar meolam lo chatafti haya nishba shevuat hattora shello chataf. uchedin ze danin bechol kayyotze baze bechol makom: 
Chataf mimmennu zehuvim [beed echad] vehu omer shelli chatafti veesrim hayu af al pi sheen haed yodea kamma chataf hare ze meshallem haesrim shehare yada bevadday shezzehuvim chataf veillu hayu shenayim haya chayyav leshallem venimtza beed echad mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava kemo shebbearnu: 
Amar hachotef esrim chatafti veshelli hen vehannigzal omer mea chataf hoil veen haed yodea minyanan hare meshallem haesrim shehoda bahen shechatafan venishba shevuat hattora al hashshear shehare nitchayyev bemiktzat. vedati nota baze sheyyishshava hesset shehare lo hoda kelum ella amar shelli chatafti: 
Nichnas leveto shel chavero shello befanav venatal mishsham kelim bifne ed echad veen haed yodea kamma natal (hare) baal habbayit omer esrim kelim hayu beveti vehaggozel omer lo natalti ella asara vehem shelli chayyav lehachezir haasara mippene shehu mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava. veeno nishba al hashshear afillu shevuat hesset mippene sheeno yachol liton al haggazlan taanat vadday:
