Asur liknot davar haggazul min haggazlan veasur lesaado al shinnuyo kede sheyyiknehu. shekkol haose devarim ellu vechayyotze bahen mechazzek yede ovre avera veover al <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl": 
Asur lehanot bedavar haggazul vaafillu leachar yeush. vehu sheyyeda bevadday sheddavar ze hu haggezela atzmah. ketzad. yada bevadday shebbehema zo gezula asur lirkov aleha o lachrosh bah: 
Gazal bayit o sade asur laavor betochah o likkanes bah bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. veim dar betochah chayyav lehaalot sachar labbealim kedin haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato. gazal dekalim veasa mehen gesher asur laavor alav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mi sheavar veachal haggezela achar yeush patur milleshallem. veim achal kodem yeush veratzu habbealim ligbot min haochel govin sheadayin birshutan hi. veim ratzu govin min haggazlan: 
Haggozel umet ben sheheechil et haggezela labbanim achar yeush ben shello heechilam ella mecharah o avda. im hinniach karka chayyavin leshallem. aval min hammittaltelin enan chayyavin leshallem. sheddeme haggezela chov hen al haggazlan veen hammittaltelin mishtabedin levaal chov: 
Kevar tikkenu haggeonim ligbot baal chov min hammittaltelin vaafillu bemilve al pe. lefichach chayyavin leshallem ben achlu ben lo achlu. ben nityaashu ben lo nityaashu. ben min hakkarka ben min hammittaltelin shehinniach: 
Din hallokeach mittaltelin min haggazlan kelokeach min haggannav. im gazlan mefursam hu lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk. veim eno mefursam asu bo takkanat hashshuk venoten hannigzal damim shennatan velokeach gezelato vechozer vetovea haggazlan bidme haggezela. veim kevar nityaashu habbealim kana lokeach atzmah shel gezela veeno machzirah: 
Asur lehanot min haggazlan veim haya miut shello af al pi sherov mamono gazul muttar lehanot mimmennu ad sheyyeda bevadday sheddavar ze gazul beyado: 
Bene adam shechezkatan gazlanin vechezkat kol mamonan min haggezel mippene shemmelachtan melechet gazlanin kegon hammochsin vehallistim asur lehanot mehen shechezkat melacha zo shehu gazul veen mitztarfim dinarim min hatteva shellahen shehakkol bechezkat gezela: 
Natlu mochsin kesuto vehecheziru lo acheret (natlu chamoro vehecheziru lo chamor acher). hare ellu shello mippene shezzo kimchira hi vechezkatah shennityaashu habbealim mimmenna veeno yodea bevadday shezzo gezela. veim haya vatik umachmir al atzmo machaziran labbealim harishonim: 
Bamme devarim amurim shehammoches kelistim bizman shehammoches akkum o moches haomed meelav o moches haomed mechamat hammelech veen lo kitzva ella lokeach ma sheyyirtze umeniach ma sheyyirtze. aval meches sheppesako hammelech veamar sheyyikkach shelish o revia o davar katzuv veheemid moches yisrael ligbot chelek ze lammelech venoda sheadam ze neeman veeno mosif kelum al ma sheggazar hammelech eno bechezkat gazlan lefi sheddin hammelech din hu. velo od ella shehu over hammavriach mimmeches ze mippene shehu gozel menat hammelech ben shehaya hammelech akkum ben shehaya hammelech yisrael: 
Vechen melech shemmesim mas al bene hair o al kol ish veish davar katzuv mishshana leshana o al kol sade vesade davar katzuv. o sheggazar shekkol mi sheyyaavor al davar ze yillakchu kol nechasav levet hammelech. o kol mi sheyyimmatze bassade bishat haggoren hu yitten hammas shealeha ben shehaya hu baal hassade ben sheeno baal hassade vechol kayyotze middevarim ellu eno gezel veyisrael sheggava otan lammelech eno bechezkat gazlan vahare hu kasher. vehu shello yosif velo yeshanne velo yikkach leatzmo kelum: 
Vechen melech shekkaas al echad meavadav veshammashav mibbene hammedina velakach sadehu o chatzero enah gezel umuttar lehanot bah vehallokchah min hammelech hare hi shello veen habbealim motziin otah miyyado. shezze din hammelachim kullam likkach kol mamon shammashehem keshekkoasin alehem vahare hammelech hifkia shibudan venaaset chatzer zo o sade zo kehefker vechol hakkone otah min hammelech zacha bah. aval melech shellakach chatzer o sade shel echad mibbene hammedina shello baddinin shechakak hare ze gazlan vehallokeach mimmennu motziin habbealim miyyado: 
Kelalo shel davar kol din sheyyachkok oto hammelech lakkol velo yihye leadam echad bifne atzmo eno gezel. vechol sheyyikkach meish ze bilvad shello kaddat hayedua lakkol ella chamas et ze hare ze gezel. lefichach gabbae hammelech veshotrav shemmochrim hassadot bemas hakkatzuv al hassadot mimkaran mimkar. aval mas sheal kol ish veish eno gove ella min haadam atzmo veim machru hassade bemas sheal harosh hare ze eno mimkar ella im ken haya din hammelech kach: 
Melech shehayu dinav shekkol shello yitten hammas sheal hassade tihye hassade lenoten hammas uvarach baal hassade mippene hammas uva ze venatan mas shealeha lammelech veachal peroteha en ze gezel ella ochel perot venoten hammas ad sheyyachzeru habbealim sheddin hammelech din hu kemo sheamarnu: 
Vechen melech sheggazar shekkol mi sheyyitten mas hakkatzuv al haish yishtabed baze shello natan uva yisrael venatan hammas sheal yisrael ze heani hare ze oved bo yoter midday sheddin hammelech din. aval eno oved bo keeved: 
Melech shekkarat ilanot shel baale battim veasa mehen gesher muttar laavor alav. vechen im haras battim vaasaan derech o choma muttar lehanot bah. vechen kol kayyotze baze sheddin hammelech din: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemelech shemmatbeo yotze beotan haaratzot shehare hiskimu alav bene otah haaretz vesamcha datan shehu adonehem vehem lo avadim. aval im en matbeo yotze hare hu kegazlan baal zeroa uchemo chavurat listim hamezuyyanin sheen dinehen din vechen melech ze vechol avadav gazlanin lechol davar:

Korot vaavanim veetzim vechayyotze bahen sheshshetafam hannahar im nityaashu habbealim mehen hare ellu muttarin vehen shel matztzilan. veim eno yodea im nityaashu im lo nityaashu chayyav lehachezir. veen tzarich lomar im hayu habbealim meraddefin acharehen: 
Lefichach hammatztzil min hannahar umizzuto shel yam umishshelulito shel nahar umin haakkum umin haddeleka umin haari umin haddov umin hannamer umin habbardelas. im yada bevadday shennityaashu habbealim hare ellu shello. veim lo yada yachzir: 
Hammatztzil miyyad listim yisrael hare ellu shello mippene shessetam haddavar shennityaashu habbealim. veim yada shello nityaashu chayyav lehachezir. aval hammatztzil miyyad listim oved kochavim o moches akkum chayyav lehachezir shessetam haddavar shello nityaashu habbealim. veim yada bevadday shennityaashu hare ellu shello. umippene ma setam listim yisrael nityaashu habbealim usetam haakkum lo nityaashu. mippene shehabbealim yodim shehaakkum machazirin miyyad haggazlan af al pi sheen sham edim sheggazal ella birayot reuot uveomed haddaat: 
Shachalayim hatztzomchim betoch happishtan hamelakketan keshehen lachin en bo mishshum gezel mippene shehen mafsidin happishtan shel baal hassade. veim yavshu asurin mishshum gezel shekkevar hifsidu ma shehifsidu. veim hayu al haggevul asurin afillu keshehen lachin: 
Kevar bearnu benizke mamon shehammotzi tivno vekashsho lirshut harabbim en bahem mishshum gezel. aval hammotzi haggalal lirshut harabbim ben bishat hotzaat zevalim ben shello bishat hotzaat zevalim chayyavin alehem mishshum gezel: 
Mi shennitchallefu lo kelav bechelim acherim bevet haavel o bevet hammishte hare ze lo yishtammesh bahen ad sheyyavo halla veyachzir veyittol et shello. nitchallefu lo bevet haumman im ishto uvanav shel umman natnu lo o shennatan lo haumman veamar lo tol kelecha hare ze lo yishtammesh bahen ad sheyyavo halla veyachzir veyittol et shello. amar lo haumman tol keli ze hare ze yishtammesh bo ad sheyyavo halla veyachzir veyittol et shello shemma kelav shel umman hu o baal hakkeli tzivva et haumman lemachro lo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Devarim harebe asru chachamim mishshum gezel vehaover alehen hare ze gazlan middivrehem. kegon mafriche yonim vehamesachakim bekubbiyya. mafriche yonim ketzad. lo yafriach adam betoch hayyishshuv shehare lokeach mamon acherim shello kaddin mippene shemmeshalleach zachar veyavi nekeva mishshovach acher o nekeva vetavi zachar. velo yonim bilvad ella kol haose kaze bishar ofot o chayya uvehema hare ze gazlan middivrehem: 
Vechen asru chachamim latzud yonim betoch hayyishshuv mippene shehen shel acherim. veen porsin nishovin leyonim ella im ken hirchik min hayyishshuv arbaa milin. veim haya yishshuv keramim afillu mea mil lo yifrosho shehayyonim shel baale keramim hem. vechen lo yifrosho betoch hashshovachin af al pi shehen shello o shel akkum o shel hefker veaf al pi shehirchik min hayyishshuv mea mil mippene shehayyonim baot leyishshuv hashshovachin: 
Marchikin et hashshovach min hair chamishshim amma. velo yaase adam shovach betoch sadehu ella im ken yesh lo chamishshim amma lechol ruach kede shello yimmashchu haggozalot veyafsidu bassadot veyochlu mishshel acherim. veim lekacho meacher afillu haya beno uven techillat sede chavero bet rova bilvad hare hu bechezkato veen mechayyevin oto leharechik: 
Hamesachakin bekubbiyya ketzad. ellu shemmesachakin beetzim o bitzrorot o baatzamot vechayyotze bahen veosim tenay benehem shekkol hannotzeach et chavero beoto sechok yikkach mimmennu kach vechach hare ze gezel middivrehem. af al pi shebbirtzon habbealim lakach hoil velakach mamon chavero bechinnam derech sechok vehittul hare ze gozel. vechen hamesachakim bivhema o bechayya o beofot veosim tenay shekkol shettenatztzeach behemto o tarutz yoter yikkach mechavero kach vechach vechol kayyotze bidvarim ellu hakkol asur vegezel middivrehem hu: 
Vehamesachek bekubbiyya im haakkum en bo issur gezel aval yesh bo issur osek bidvarim betelim sheen rauy leadam sheyyaasok kol yamav ella bedivre chachma uveyishshuvo shel olam: 
Metzudot chayya veofot vedagim shennaflu mine hachayya letoch hammetzuda uva acher unetalan hare ze gezel middivrehem mippene sheadayin lo higgiu leyad hazzoche bahen: 
Nahar hammoshech umayanot hannovin hare hen shel kol adam. ani hamenakkef berosh hazzayit zetim shel shichcha uva ani acher unetalan meal haaretz hare ze gezel middivrehem. veim haya heani mekabbetz beyado berosh hazzayit umashlich laaretz hare ze gezel gamur shehare higgiu leyad hazzoche bahen: 
Haddevorim enan birshuto shel adam kemo tarnegolim vaavazim veaf al pi chen yesh bahen kinyan middivrehem. vehaggozel nechil devorim o shemmenao mibbealav im ba lirshuto hare ze gezel middivrehem. lefichach mi sheyyatza nechil shel devorim mershuto veshachan birshut chavero yesh levaal hannechil lehallech betoch sede chavero ad sheyyittol et nechilo. veim hizzik meshallem ma shehizzik. aval lo yakotz et socho al menat litten damim: 
Neemenet ishsha o katan lomar mikkan yatza nechil ze vehu sheyyihyu mesichin lefi tumman veyihyu habbealim meraddefin achar hannechil veshoalim hechan chone. veaf al pi sheen ishsha o katan bene edut hoil vekinyan devorim middivrehem heeminu otam bo: 
Kol mi sheyyesh beyado gezel shel divrehem eno yotze miyyado bedayyanin. vechen im kafar bo venishba eno mosif chomesh kemo shemmosif al haggezel haggamur:

Kol mi shennitchayyev mamon lachavero hayyisrael vechafar bo venishba al sheker hare ze chayyav lehachezir lo hakkeren shekkafar bo vehosafat chomesh. vechayyav bekarban vehu hannikra asham gezelot: 
Echad haggozel o haoshek o haggonev o shehilvahu o shehifkid etzlo o matza aveda vechichesh bah o shehayta benehen shuttafut venishar lo etzlo mamon o sheasa lo melacha velo natan lo secharo. kelalo shel davar kol sheillu hoda chayyav leshallem bedin vechafar venishba meshallem keren vechomesh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 21)</small> "vechichesh baamito befikkadon": 
Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya chayyav leshallem mechamat atzmo. aval im haya chayyav leshallem mechamat aviv eno meshallem chomesh. ketzad. kegon sheggazal aviv o ganav o shehaya chayyav laacherim vehabben yodea vechafar habben venishba veachar kach hoda meshallem hakkeren bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 23)</small> "asher gazal" al gezelo hu mosif chomesh veeno mosif chomesh al gezel aviv: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheen haggezela kayyemet. aval im gazal aviv umet vehaggezela kayyemet vechafar hayyoresh venishba veachar kach hoda meshallem keren vechomesh: 
Gazal haav venishba haav vehoda veachar kach met hare hayyoresh meshallem keren vechomesh: 
Gazal venishba umet vehoda hayyoresh meshallem hakkeren bilvad. uven kach uven kach hayyoresh patur min haasham: 
Hannishba leakkum meshallem et hakkeren veeno chayyav bechomesh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 21)</small> "vechichesh baamito". vechen haggozel pachot mishsheve peruta vechafar venishba eno chayyav bechomesh sheen pachot mishsheve peruta mamon. kamma hu hachomesh. echad mearbaa bekeren sheim gazal sheve arbaa venishba meshallem chamishsha. veim hayta haggezela kayyemet machzir otah venoten deme revia shellah: 
En hannishba al kefirat mamon meshallem chomesh ad sheyyode meatzmo. aval im bau edim vehu omed bichfirato meshallem hakkeren bilvad al pi edim veeno meshallem et hachomesh. shehachomesh im hakkarban lechappara hem baim veeno mevian ella al pi atzmo: 
Haggozel et chavero af al pi shekkafar bo hoil velo nishba im chazar vehoda eno chayyav lirdof achar habbealim ad sheyyachzir lahem mamon shebbeyado ella yehe beyad haggazlan ad sheyyavou habbealim veyittelu shellahen. aval im nishba al sheve peruta vamala chayyav lirdof achar habbealim ad sheyyachzir lahem afillu hem beiyye hayyam. mippene shekkevar nityaashu meachar shennishba veenan bain od letavo: 
Afillu hechzir haggezela kullah chutz mishsheve peruta chayyav leholichah achar hannigzal. velo yitten lo livno shel nigzal velo lishlucho ella im ken asa hannigzal hashshaliach beedim. veim hevi et haggezela veet hachomesh levet din shebbeiro hare ze mevi asham umitkapper lo uvet din metappelin bah ad shettaggia levaalah. vechen noten hu lishliach bet din. vechol hannoten haggezela vechayyotze bo levet din yatza: 
Natan lo et hakkeren velo natan lo et hachomesh o shemmachal lo al hakkeren velo machal lo al hachomesh o shemmachal lo al ze veal ze chutz mippachot mishsheve peruta bakkeren eno tzarich leholich acharav ella yavo hannigzal veyittol et hashshear. veaf al pi shehaggezela atzmah kayyemet en choshshin shemma tityakker venimtza hannishar sheve peruta. aval im natan lo et hachomesh velo natan lo et hakkeren o shemmachal lo al hachomesh velo machal lo al hakkeren o shemmachal lo al ze veal ze chutz mishsheve peruta bakkeren chayyav leholicho acharav o latet levet din shebbeiro kemo shebbearnu: 
Hammachazir et hakkeren labbealim vechafar paam sheniyya bachomesh venishba alav naasa hachomesh kekeren lechol davar umeshallem alav chomesh acher shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 24)</small> "vachamishitav yosef alav" melammed shehu mosif chomesh al chomesh ad sheyyitmaet hachomesh sheyyichpor bo venishba alav mishsheve peruta: 
Mi shehaya etzlo pikkadon vetaan sheavad venishba vechazar vehoda shehu etzlo. vechazar vetaan sheavad venishba vechazar vehoda shehu etzlo meshallem chomesh lechol shevua ushevua im hakkeren haechad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 24)</small> "vachamishitav yosef alav" melammed shehu meshallem kamma chomashin al keren echad:
Haggozel et chavero umet hannigzal yachzir haggezela layyorshim. veim avda o nishtannet noten lahem dameha. veim nishba lo veachar kach met noten layyorshim hakkeren vehachomesh:

Haggozel et aviv venishba lo umet haav. im en haggezela kayyemet o nishtannet ose cheshbon im echav al hakkeren veal hachomesh. veim haggezela kayyemet chayyav lehotzi haggezela atzmah mittachat yado. lefichach noten et haggezela veet hachomesh leechav veose immahen cheshbon:

Im en lo achin shennimtza ze haggazlan levaddo hu hayyoresh motzi haggezela mittachat yado levanav veim en banim leze habben haggazlan notnah levaal chovo o behalevaato o litzdaka. hoil veyatza haggezela atzmah mittachat yado niftar af al pi shennetanah mattana o peraah bechovo. vehu sheyyodiem veyomar ze gezel abba:
Vechen haggozel et hagger venishba lo vechazar vehoda lo vezakaf alav hakkol milve veachar kach met hagger af al pi shezzacha baggezela chayyav lehotziah mittachat yado:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehoda bentayim. aval im gazal et hagger sheen lo yorshim venishba lo umet hagger hare ze chayyav leshallem hakkeren vechomesh lakkohanim shel oto mishmar umevi ashamo veachar kach yitkapper bo:

Mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar battora <small>(Bamidbar 5 8)</small> "veim en laish goel" beger shemmet veen lo yorshim hakkatuv medabber veasham ze haamur kan hu haggezela o dameha. lefichach hammachazir gezel hagger ballayla lo yatza. shehare asham kerao hakkatuv veen makrivin ballayla. veen hakkohanim cholkin gezel hagger keneged gezel hagger kederech sheen cholkin besar asham neged besar asham acher:

Kol gezel hagger sheen bo sheve peruta lechol kohen vechohen meanshe mishmar lo yatza hammachziro yede hashava shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 8)</small> "hammushav laAdonai lakkohen" ad shettihye hashava lechol kohen. velamma neemar begezel hagger <small>(Bamidbar 5 8)</small> "ish" shehaish atta tzarich lachkor ulechazzer alav im yesh lo yorshim o im en lo aval im haya hagger katan i atta tzarich lechazzer alav ella chezkato sheen lo yorshim:

Hakkohanim begezel hagger kimkabbele mattanot hen. lefichach haggozel chametz min hagger sheen lo yorshim veavar alav happesach chayyav litten lakkohanim et damav kishat haggezela. sheim yittenehu lahen achshav enah mattana shehare hu asur bahanaa. veillu haya hagger kayyam haya omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha kemo shebbearnu:
Kohen sheggazal ger sheen lo yorshim venishba lo umet hagger lo zacha ze bigzelo shettachat yado ella yotzi mittachat yado lechol echav hakkohanim bene hammishmeret:

Haggozel et hagger venishba lo umet hagger vehifrish ashamo ugezelato lehaalotan lakkohanim umet haggazlan kodem kappara hare bene haggazlan yorshim et kesef haggezela o haggezela atzmah vehaasham yire ad sheyyippol bo mum kemo shebbearnu bimkomo:

Natan haggazlan et hakkesef leanshe mishmar umet kodem kappara en yorshe haggazlan yecholin lehotzi miyyad hakkohanim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 10)</small> "ish asher yitten lakkohen lo yihye". vaafillu haya haggazlan katan sheen mattenato mattana en yorshav motziin miyyad hakkohanim:

Natan et hakkesef leachat min hammishmarot veet haasham lemishmara zo shehi shabbattah yachzir hakkesef etzel haasham leanshe hammishmara hakkevua shehammishmara shellakcha kesef belo shabbattah lo zachta umotziin miyyadah:

En makrivin et haasham ad sheyyachzir haggazlan hakkeren labbealim o lakkohanim im haya gezel ger sheen lo yorshim. natan et hakkeren vehikriv ashamo nitkapper lo veen hachomesh meakkev hakkappara vechayyav litten et hachomesh achar kappara:

Haavadim vehashshetarot vehakkarkaot en bahen tosefet chomesh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 21)</small> "vechichesh baamito befikkadon". kol haamur bainyan mittaltelin hu vegufan mamon. yatzu karkaot vaavadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot veyatzu shetarot sheen gufan mamon. vechen im hayu gezel ger sheen lo yorshim enan chozrim lakkohanim. vechen hakkarka enah niknet leolam laggazlan ella birshut bealeha omedet. vaafillu nimkera leelef ze achar ze venityaashu habbealim hare zo chozeret lannigzal belo damim. vechol mi sheyyatza mittachat yado chozeret al ze shemmecharah lo vechozer hammocher hashsheni al hammocher harishon ad sheyyachazor hallokeach min haggazlan al haggazlan veyittol mimmennu kemo sheyyitbaer:

Haggozel karka mechavero vehifsidah. kegon shechafar bah borot shichin umearot o shekkatzatz et hailanot veshichet et hammayanot veharas habbinyan. chayyav lehaamid lo bayit o sade keshehayu bishat haggezela o yeshallem deme ma shehifsid. aval im nishchata meeleha kegon sheshshetafah nahar o nisrefa beesh sheyyarda min hashshamayim omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha shehakkarka bechezkat bealim kayyemet veen acharayut hefsedah alav ella im ken hifsid beyado. ma sheen haddin ken bemittaltelin kemo shebbearnu: 
Gazal sade venigzela mimmennu unetaluha metzikim bechoach hammelech. im makkat medina hi kegon shellakach hammelech sadot o battim shel kol anshe hammedina omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha. veim mechamat haggazlan nilkecha chayyav lehaamid lo sade acheret: 
Anas hammelech et haggazlan veamar lo haree lanu kol ma sheyyesh lecha vehera sade zo sheggazal bichlal sedotav unetalah hammelech. chayyav lehaamid lo sade acheret kemotah o noten dameha: 
Gazal sade vehifsidah beyado keshebbaal hassade gove et deme ma shehifsid haggazlan gove otan minnechasim bene chorin mippene shehi kemilve al pe. veim amad haggazlan baddin venitchayyev leshallem veachar kach machar gove minnechasim meshubadin: 
Gazal sade veachal peroteha meshallem kol happerot sheachal minnechasim bene chorin. gazal vehishbiach shamin lo veyado al hattachtona im hashshevach yeter al hahotzaa notel hahotzaa bilvad min hannigzal veim hahotzaa yetera al hashshevach en lo min hahotzaa ella shiur hashshevach: 
Gazal sade umecharah vehishbichah hallokeach im hashshevach yater al hahotzaa notel hahotzaa mibbaal hassade vehakkeren notel im shear hashshevach min haggazlan: 
Hakkeren gove minnechasim meshubadim ushear hashshevach minnechasim bene chorin. veim hikkir bah shehi gezula keshellekachah eno notel min haggazlan ella hakkeren bilvad umafsid shear hashshevach hayyater al hahotzaa. hayta hahotzaa yetera al hashshevach ben shehikkir bah shehi gezula ben shello hikkir bah en lo min hahotzaa ella shiur hashshevach notel mibbaal hassade vehakkeren notel min haggazlan minnechasim meshubadin: 
Haggozel sade umecharah veachal hallokeach peroteha mechashshevin alav kol happerot sheachal umeshallem levaal hassade vechozer vegove otan min haggazlan minnechasim bene chorin. veim hikkir bah sheggezula hi en lo perot veeno gove min haggazlan ella hakkeren bilvad: 
Hammocher sade sheenah shello en mimkaro mimkar velo kana lokeach kelum kemo shebbearnu. chazar haggazlan achar shemmecharah ulekachah mibbealeha nitkayyema beyad hallokeach min haggazlan. vaafillu netanah lo haggazlan mattana keshehayta gezula beyado kevan shechazar ulekachah nitkayyema beyad ze shekkibbel hammattana shemmippene ze tarach haggazlan ad shekkenaah kede laamod beneemanuto: 
Lefichach im tava hallokeach et haggazlan mippene shemmachar lo sade sheenah shello venitchayyev leshallem vehitchil bet din lehacheriz al nichse haggazlan kede lehagebot mehen lallokeach veachar shehitchilu hahachraza lekachah haggazlan min habbealim lo nitkayyema beyad hallokeach. shemmeachar shehichrizu al nechasav nitgalla sheeno neeman velo lekachah min habbealim kede lehaamidah beyad hallokeach: 
Lekachah haggazlan min habbealim achar shemmecharah keshehi gezula vechazar umecharah leacher o netanah bemattana o horishah. hare gilla dato sheeno rotze lehaamidah beyad ze shellekachah mimmennu keshehayta gezula. vechen im nafla laggazlan birushsha lo nitkayyema beyad hallokeach: 
Gevaah haggazlan bechovo. im yesh lannigzal karka acheret veamar lo haggazlan zo ani gove bechovi hare ze mitkavven lehaamidah beyad hallokeach. veim en lannigzal karka ella zo ligbot chovo hu shennitkavven: 
Netanuha habbealim laggazlan mattana kenaah hallokeach sheillu lo tarach labbealim lo hayu notnim lo bemattana umippene ze tarach kede sheyyizke bah bedin veyaamod beneemanuto vetitkayyem beyad hallokeach: 
Haggozel sade veachar sheggezalah vehuchzak gazlan aleha chazar ulekachah mibbealim harishonim vetaan hannigzal veamar anus hayiti beshaa shemmechartiha lo veshello ledati macharti mechamat gazlanuto lo zacha haggazlan af al pi sheyyesh lo edim shebbifnehem lekachah vetachzor hassade labbealim umachzirin laggazlan haddamim shennatan: 
Bamme devarim amurim kesheheidu haedim shemmana bifnehem et hammaot. aval im heidu shebbaal hakkarka machar laggazlan vehoda lo bifnehem shennatan lo damim kach vechach vehannigzal toen shello natan lo damim umechamat yira hoda lo en laggazlan kelum ella motziin mimmennu hassade belo damim mippene shello hoda lo ella mippene happachad keshettaan hoil vehuchzak gazlan aleha: 
En baal hassade tzarich laasot modaa al mecher ze hoil vehuchzak ze gazlan al sade zo veen reayato bah reaya. veen tzarich limsor modaa. veen din gazlan kedin haones et chavero vetala oto ad sheyyimkor lo. shezze haones eno rotze ligzol velo gezalo adayin kelum. lefichach im lo masar hammocher haanus modaa mimkaro kayyam:

Akkum baal zeroa sheanas nichse yisrael veyarad letoch sadehu mechamat shehaya lo chov al baal hassade o mechamat sheyyesh lo nezek beyad ze hayyisrael o mechamat shehifsid mamono. veachar shettakaf lo et hassade mecharah leyisrael acher. en habbealim yecholin lehotzi miyyad hallokeach: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshehodu habbealim sheemet taan haakkum [hammocher o yaidu ede yisrael shehaemet taan haakkum] hammocher. vechen im haya sham melech o sar beoto makom sheyyachol lachof et haakkum shemmachar ledin velo tavu habbealim et haakkum enan yecholin lehotzi miyyad hallokeach min haakkum af al pi sheenan modin laakkum veaf al pi sheen sham edim sheemet taan haakkum shehare omer hallokeach labbealim im gazlan hu haakkum lamma lo tevatem oto bedinehem: 
Haakkum hammetzikim leyisrael umevakkeshim lehargam ad sheyyifde atzmo miyyad haakkum besadehu o beveto veyittenenna lammetzik veachar kach yannichennu. kesheyyirtze hammetzik limkor otah hakkarka im yesh beyad habbealim likkach min hammetzik hen kodmin lechol adam. veim en beyad habbealim likkach o sheshshaha hakkarka beyad hammetzik shenem asar chodesh kol hakkodem velakach min hammetzik zacha. uvilvad sheyyitten labbealim harishonim revia hakkarka o shelish hammaot mippene shezze hammetzik mocher bezol hoil vekarka sheenah shello hu mocher hare ze mocher befachot revia o karov lo veze revia shel bealim shehare mechamat shehi shellahen mocher bezol. lefichach hallokeach min hammetzik bishloshim noten labbealim asara o noten lahem revia hakkarka veachar kach yikne hakkol. veim lo natan hare revia hakkarka kegezel beyado: 
Hayyored letoch sede chavero shello birshut unetaah im hayta sade haasuya litta omdin kamma adam rotze litten besade zo litteah venotel mibbaal hassade. veim enah asuya litta shamin lo veyado al hattachtona: 
Amar lo baal hassade akor ilancha velech shomim lo. amar hannotea hareni oker ilani en shomin lo mippene shemmachchish et hakkarka: 
Hachatzerot hare hen reuyin levinyan ulehosif bahen battim vaaliyyot. lefichach horu haggeonim shehabbone bachatzar chavero shello middato hare ze kenotea sade haasuya litta veshamin lo kamma adam rotze litten bevinyan ze livnoto. vehu sheyyivne binyan hammoil harauy leotah chatzer keminhag oto makom: 
Hayyored lisde chavero birshut afillu nata sade sheenah asuya litta shamin lo veyado al haelyona. sheim hayta hahotzaa yeter al hashshevach notel hahotzaa veim hashshevach yeter al hahotzaa notel hashshevach. uvaal benichse ishto vehashshuttaf besade sheyyesh lo chelek bah keyored birshut hen veshamin lahem veyadam al haelyona: 
Hayyored lisde chavero shello birshut venata o bana veachar kach ba baal hassade vehishlim habbinyan o sheshshamar hannetiot vechayyotze beellu haddevarim shemmarin sheddato nota lema sheasa ze uvirtzono ba haddavar shamin lo veyado al haelyona: 
Hayyored letoch churbato shel chavero uvenaah shello birshut shamin lo veyado al hattachtona. veim amar baal habbinyan etzay vaavanay ani notel. babbayit shomin lo. bassade en shomin lo mippene shemmachchish et hakkarka. amar lo baal hakkarka tol ma shebbanita shomin lo: 
Kol mi sheshshamin lo ben shehayta yado al haelyona ben shehayta yado al hattachtona eno notel kelum ad sheyyishshava binkitat chefetz kamma hotzi. veim amar yavou haddayyanim veyaasu shumat hahotzaa vahare hi geluya leenehem vishaaru haetzim vehaavanim vehassid usechar haummanin bappachut shebbashshearim shomin lo venotel belo shevua. vechen ze shennotel hashshevach bilvad vehayta yado al haelyona en tzarich shevua: 
Kol sheshshamin lo venotel shettaan baal hassade veamar natatti vehayyored lassade omer lo natalti. hayyored neeman venishba shello natan lo kelum venotel shehare omrin levaal hassade adayin lo shamu lecha velo yadata kamma atta chayyav litten heach natatta. aval im shamu lo veamru levaal hassade ten lo veamar natatti af al pi sheadayin lo nishba hayyored hare baal hassade neeman veyishshava shevuat hesset shennatan veyippater. shehakkarka bechezkat bealeha: 
Baal shehorid arisin benichse ishto veachar kach gershah. im haya habbaal atzmo aris nistallek baal nistalleku arisav shello yardu lah ella al daat habbaal. veshamin lahem veyadam al hattachtona. veim en habbaal aris al daat hakkarka yardu veshamin lahem kearis:

Hashavat aveda leyisrael mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 1)</small> "hashev teshivem". veharoe avedat yisrael venitallem mimmenna vehenichah over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 1)</small> "lo tire et shor achicha" <small>(Devarim 22 1)</small> "vehitallamta mehem". uvittel mitzvat ase. veim heshivah kiyyem mitzvat ase: 
Lakach et haaveda velo heshivah bittel mitzvat ase veavar al shene lavin al <small>(Devarim 22 3)</small> "lo tuchal lehitallem" veal <small>(Vayikra 19 13)</small> "lo tigzl". afillu haya baal haaveda rasha veochel nevela leteavon vechayyotze bo mitzva lehashiv lo avedato. aval ochel nevela lehacheis hare hu eppikoros vehaeppikorosim veovde akkum umechallele shabbat befarhesya asur lehachezir lahen aveda keakkum: 
Avedat oved akkum mutteret shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 3)</small> "avedat achicha". vehammachazirah hare ze over avera mippene shehu machazik yad rishe olam. veim hechezirah lekaddesh et hashshem kede sheyyefaaru et yisrael veyedu shehem baale emuna hare ze meshubbach. uvemakom sheyyesh chillul hashshem avedato asura vechayyav lehachezirah. uvechol makom machnisin kelehem mippene haggannavim kichle yisrael mippene darche shalom: 
Taut haakkum kaavedato umutteret. vehu shettaa meatzmo aval lehateoto asur: 
Ketzad. kegon sheasa haakkum cheshbon vetaa. vetzarich sheyyomar lo yisrael ree sheal cheshboncha ani somech veeni yodea ella ma sheatta omer ani noten lecha kegon ze muttar. aval im lo amar lo ken asur shemma yitkavven haggoy levadko venimtza shem shamayim mitchallel: 
Ir sheyyisreelim veakkum darin bah umechetza akkum umechetza yisrael umatza bah aveda notel umachriz. veim ba yisrael venatan simaneha chayyav lehachezir: 
Haya rov hair akkum im matza bemakom min hair sherov hammetzuyim sham yisrael chayyav lehacheriz. aval im matza bisratya ufelatya gedola bevatte kenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot shehaakkum metzuyin sham tamid uvechol makom sheharabbim metzuyin sham hare hammetzia shello. vaafillu ba yisrael venatan simaneha. shehare nityaesh mimmenna keshennafla mippene shehu omer akkum metzaah af al pi shehi shello. harotze lelech bederech hattov vehayyashar veose lefanim mishshurat haddin machzir et haaveda leyisrael kesheyyitten et simaneha: 
Matza beir zo sherubbah akkum chavit shel yayin yenah asur bahanaa vekankannah muttar mishshum aveda. veim ba yisrael venatan simaneha muttar bishtiyya leze yisrael shemmetzaah: 
Of shechataf basar vehishlicho bechatzer acheret af al pi sherov hair yisrael hare ze muttar mishshum aveda shehare nityaashu habbealim mimmennu: 
Hammotze aveda bezuto shel yam uvishlulito shel nahar sheeno posek af al pi sheyyesh bah siman hare zo shel motzah shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 3)</small> "asher tovad mimmennu umetzatah". mi sheavuda mimmennu umetzuya hi etzel kol adam. yatzat zo sheavuda mimmennu umikkol adam shezze vadday nityaesh mimmenna: 
Hameabbed mamono ledaat en nizkakin lo. ketzad. hinniach parato berefet sheen lah delet velo kesharah vehalach lo. hishlich kiso birshut harabbim vehalach lo vechol kayyotze baze. hare ze ibbed mamono ledato. veaf al pi sheasur leroe davar ze littol leatzmo eno zakuk lehachezir shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 3)</small> "asher tovad" perat limabbed ledato: 
Aveda sheen bah sheve peruta eno chayyav lehittappel velo lehachezirah: 
Matza sak o kuppa im haya chacham o zaken mechubbad sheen darko littol kelim ellu beyado eno chayyav lehittappel bahen veomed et dato illu hayu shello im haya machaziran leatzmo kach chayyav lehachezir shel chavero. veim lo haya mochel al kevodo afillu haya shello kach beshel chavero eno chayyav lehachezir. haya darko lehachezir kelim kaellu bassade veen darko lehacheziran bair umetzaan bair eno chayyav lehachezir. metzaan bassade chayyav lehacheziran ad sheyyaggiu lirshut habbealim. veaf al pi shehare nichnas bahen lair veen darko bechach: 
Vechen im matza behema vehikkishah nitchayyev lehittappel bah ulehachazirah af al pi sheenah lefi kevodo shehare hitchil bammitzva. hechezirah uvarcha afillu mea peamim chayyav lehachezir shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 1)</small> "hashev teshivem" hashev afillu mea peamim mashmao. leolam hu chayyav lehittappel bah ad sheyyachazirennah lirshut bealeha lemakom hammishtammer. aval im hechezirah lemakom sheen mishtammer kegon ginna vechurba veavda mishsham chayyav beacharayutah: 
Hechzir et haaveda beshacharit lemakom shehabbealim nichnasin veyotzin sham beshacharit eno chayyav lehittappel bah shehare habbealim roin otah af al pi shehu makom sheeno mishtammer. bamme devarim amurim bedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim. aval bevaale chayyim leolam chayyav lehittappel bah ad sheyyachnisenna lirshut habbealim hammishtammeret. veeno tzarich daat bealim: 
Raa behema shebbarcha min haddir vehechezirah limkomah hare ze kiyyem hammitzva veeno tzarich daat habbealim: 
Haholech bederech hattov vehayyashar veose lifnim mishshurat haddin machzir et haaveda bechol makom af al pi sheenah lefi kevodo: 
Kohen sheraa haaveda bevet hakkevarot eno mittamme lehachezirah shebbeet shemmekayyem mitzvat ase shel heshshev aveda mevattel ase shel <small>(Vayikra 21 6)</small> "kedshim yihyu" veover al lo taase shel <small>(Vayikra 21 4)</small> "lo yittamma baal beammav" veen ase doche et lo taase vaase: 
Raa et haaveda veamar lo aviv al tachzirenna yachzir velo yekabbel mimmennu. sheim kibbel meaviv nimtza beet shekkiyyem mitzvat ase shel <small>(Shemot 20 12)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 16)</small> "kabbed et avicha" bittel ase shel <small>(Devarim 22 1)</small> "hashev teshivem" veavar al <small>(Devarim 22 3)</small> "lo tuchal lehitallem": 
Haroe mayim shotfin uvain lehashechit binyan chavero o sadehu chayyav ligdor bifnehem ulemanam shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 3)</small> "lechol avedat achicha" lerabbot avedat karkao:

Mi sheavda lo aveda ufaga baavedato vaavedat chavero im yachol lehachezir shetehen chayyav lehachezir shetehen veim eno yachol lehachezir ella achat mehen avedato kodemet vaafillu laavedat aviv o shel rabbo shello kodem lechol adam:
Paga baavedat rabbo im avedat aviv im haya aviv shakul keneged rabbo shel aviv kodemet veim lav shel rabbo kodemet. vehu sheyyihye rabbo muvhak sherov chachmato shel tora mimmennu lamad:

Heniach avedato vehechzir avedat chavero en lo ella sachar harauy lo. ketzad. shataf nahar chamoro vachamor chavero shello yafe mane veshel chavero matayim. hinniach et shello vehitztzil et shel chavero en lo ella secharo harauy lo. veim amar lo atztzil et shellecha veatta noten li deme shelli o shehitna bifne bet din chayyav litten lo deme shello. veaf al pi shechamoro ala meelav. hoil velo nitassek bo zacha bema shehitna immo:

Yarad lehatztzil velo hitztzil en lo ella secharo harauy lo. vechen im haya osek bimlacha uvittel mimmelachto sheshshava dinar vehechzir aveda sheshshava mea dinar lo yomar lo ten li dinar shehifsadti ella noten lo secharo kefoel batel sheyyibbatel meotah melacha shehaya osek bah. veim hitna im habbealim o bifne bet din sheyyittol ma sheyyafsid vehirshuhu hare ze notel. veim en sham bealim velo bet din shello kodem:

Vechen shenayim shehayu baim bederech ze bechavit shel yayin veze bechad shel devash venisdak hakkad shel devash vekodem sheyyishshafech haddevash laaretz shafach ze et yeno vehitztzil et haddevash letoch hechavit en lo ella secharo harauy lo. veim amar atztzil et shellecha veatta noten li deme shelli o shehitna bifne bet din hare ze chayyav litten lo. veim nishpach haddevash laaretz hare ze hefker vechol hammatztzil leatzmo matztzil:

Haya ze ba bechad shel devash veze ba bekankannim rekanim venisdeka kad haddevash veamar lo baal hakkankannim eni matztzil lecha devash ze bekankannay ad shettitten li chetzyo o shelisho o kach vechach dinarin vekibbel alav baal haddevash veamar lo hen hare ze sachak bo veeno noten lo ella secharo harauy lo shehare lo hifsido kelum:

Vechen mi shebbarach mibbet haasurim vehayta maboret lefanav veamar lo haavireni vaani noten lecha dinar veheeviro en lo ella secharo harauy lo. veim haya tzayyad veamar lo battel metzudatcha vehaavireni noten lo kol ma shehitna immo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Shayyara shehayta holechet bammidbar veamad aleha gayis uterafah im enan yecholin lehatztzil miyyadam veamad echad mehen vehitztzil hitztzil leatzmo. veim yecholin hen lehatztzil miyyadam vekadam echad mehen vehitztzil af al pi sheamar leatzmi ani matztzil hitztzil laemtza:

Hayu yecholin lehatztzil al yede haddechak kol hammatztzil matztzil laemtza ella im ken amar leatzmi ani matztzil hare ze matztzil leatzmo. shekkevan sheshshemauhu omer leatzmi ani matztzil haya lahen lidchok atzman ulehatztzil vechevan sheyyashvu velo hitztzilu hare nityaashu min hakkol:

Hayu shene shuttafin vehitztzil echad mehen hitztzil laemtza. veim amar leatzmi ani matztzil hare ze chalak mechavero vehitztzil leatzmo. vechen hassocher et happoel lehatztzil kol sheyyatztzil hare hu lammaskir veim amar leatzmi ani matztzil hare ze chozer bo min hassechirut vechol sheyyatztzil achar sheamar ken hare hu shello:

Shayyara shechanta bammidbar veamad aleha gayis letarfah ufasku im haggayis mamon venatnu lo. mechashshevin lefi mamonam veen mechashshevin lefi nefashot. veim sachru tayyar lifnehem lehodiam hadderech mechashshevin secharo lefi mamon ulefi nefashot. veal yeshannu mimminhag hachammarim:
Rashshain hachammarim lehatenot benehen kol mi shettovad mimmennu chamor mibbene hashshayyara maamidin lo chamor acheret. veim pasha bah hu veavda en chayyavin lehaamid lo:

Avda chamoro veamar tenu li dameha veeni rotze likkach chamor vahareni shomer immachem en shomin lo ella maamidin lo chamor acheret kede sheyyizdarez atzmo veyishmor behemto. vaafillu hayta lo behema acheret bashshayyara eno dome shomer achat leshomer shetayim:
Sefina shehayta mehallechet bayyam veamad aleha nachshol letabbeah vehekellu mimmassaah. mechashshevin lefi massooy veen mechashshevin lefi mamon. veal yeshannu mimminhag hassappanim:

Rashshain hassappanim lehatenot benehen kol mi shettovad lo sefina maamidim lo sefina acheret. pasha bah veavda o shepperash lemakom sheen hassefinot holchot bo beoto hazzeman en chayyavin lehaamid lo:

Hammotze aveda shehu chayyav lehachezirah chayyav lehacheriz aleha ulehodiah velomar mi sheavad lo min peloni yavo veyitten simanin veyittol. afillu hayta shava peruta beet hammetzia vehuzela chayyav lehacheriz aleha. veeven gevoha hayta chutz lirushalayim shealeha hayu machrizin: 
Ketzad machriz. im matza maot machriz mi sheavad lo matbea. vechen machriz mi sheavad lo kesut o behema o shetarot yavo veyitten simanim veyittol veeno choshesh mippene shehodia min haaveda lefi sheeno machziro ad sheyyitten simanim muvhakin: 
Ba baal haaveda venatan simanim sheenan muvhakin en machazirin lo ad sheyyomar simanim muvhakin. veharammay af al pi sheamar simanim muvhakin en machazirin lo ad sheyyovi edim shehi shello. amru chachamim <small>(Devarim 22 2)</small> "vehaya immecha ad derosh achicha" ad shettachkor acharav im rammay hu im lav: 
Barishona kol mi sheavad lo aveda uva venatan simaneha machazirin otah lo ella im ken huchzak rammay. mishsherabbu harammain hitkinu bet din sheyyehu omrin lo have edim sheen atta rammay vetol: 
Hassimanim hammuvhakin somchin alehem vedanin al pihem bechol makom din tora. vehammidda o hammishkal o hamminyan o mekom haaveda simanin muvhakin hen: 
Bau shenayim ze natan simane haaveda veze natan simane haaveda kemo shennatan haacher lo yitten lo laze velo laze ella tihye munnachat ad sheyyode haechad lachavero o yaasu benehen peshara. natan haechad et hassimanim vehashsheni hevi edim yitten levaal haedim. ze natan simanim veze natan simanim veed echad hare haed haechad kemo sheeno veyanniach: 
Matza simla vechayyotze bah veze hevi ede ariga shearaguha lo veze hevi edim shennafla mimmennu yitten leede nefila. ze natan middat arkah veze natan middat rachbah yitten lemi shennatan middat arkah sheefshar sheyyeshaer harammay middat rachbah keshehaya bealeha mitkasse bah. ze natan middat arkah verachbah veze kivven mishkeloteha yitten lemi shekkivven mishkalah. ze natan middat arkah verachbah veze natan middat haimriyyot shebbah yitten lemi shennatan middat arkah verachbah: 
Barishona kol mi shemmatza aveda haya machriz aleha shelosha regalim. regel rishon omer rishon. sheni omer sheni. shelishi machriz setam kede shello yitchallef lo sheni bishlishi. veachar regel haacharon beshivat yamim machriz paam reviit. kede sheyyelech hashshomea leveto bishlosha yamim vimashshesh kelav veyachzor bishloshet hayyamim veyimtza ze hammachriz machriz bashshevii: 
Mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkinu sheyyehu machrizin bevatte kenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot. mishsherabbu hoonasin veamru hammetzia shel melech hi hitkinu sheyyihyu modiin lishchenav velimyuddaav vedayyo: 
Hichriz o hodia velo bau habbealim tihye hammetzia munnachat etzlo ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. uvechol zeman shehaaveda etzlo im nigneva o avda chayyav beacharayutah. veim neensa patur sheshshomer aveda keshomer sachar hu mippene shehu osek bemitzva veniftar mikkamma mitzvot ase kol zeman shehu osek bishmiratah: 
Vetzarich levakker et haaveda ulevadkah kede shello tippased vetovad meeleha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 2)</small> "vahashevoto lo" ree heach teshivennu lo. ketzad. matza kesut shel tzemer menaarah achat lishloshim yom. velo yenaarenna bemakkel velo bishne bene adam. veshotchah al gabbe mitta letzarkah bilvad aval lo letzarkah uletzarko. nizdammenu lo orchim lo yishtechenna bifnehem vaafillu letzarkah shemma tigganev: 
Matza kele etz mishtammesh bahen kede shello yerakvu. kele nechoshet mishtammesh bahen bechammin aval lo al yede haur mippene shemmashchikan. kele kesef mishtammesh bahen betzonen aval lo bechammin mippene shemmashchiran. matza maggerefot vekardummot yishtammesh bahen berach aval lo bekashe mippene shemmafchitan. matza kele zahav uchele zechuchit uchesut shel pishtan hare ze lo yigga bahen ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. uchederech sheamru baaveda kach amru befikkadon shehalchu bealav limdinat hayyam: 
Matza sefarim kore bahen achat lishloshim yom veim eno yodea likrot gollan kol sheloshim yom. uleolam lo yilmod bahen lechattechilla. velo yikra parasha veyishne. velo yikra parasha vitargem. velo yiftach bo yeter mishshelosha dappin. velo yihyu shenayim korin bishne inyanin shemma yimshoch ze veyimshoch ze veyivle hassefer. aval korin hen beinyan echad. velo yikreu shelosha besefer echad vaafillu beinyan echad: 
Matza tefillin sham demehen umenichan alav sheddavar matzuy hu beyad hakkol veen asuyin ella lemitzvatan bilvad: 
Matza davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim shehare tzarich hu lehaachilo. im haya davar sheose veochel kegon para vachamor metappel bahen shenem asar chodesh miyyom hammetzia umaskiran velokeach sachar umaachil. veim haya secharan yeter al achilatan hare hayyeter labbealim. vechen hattarnegolin mocher betzehen umaachilan kol shenem asar chodesh. mikkan veelach sham demehen alav vahare hen shello veshel bealim beshuttafut kedin kol hashsham behema mechavero: 
Matza agalim useyachin shel rei metappel bahen shelosha chodashim. veshel beria sheloshim yom. avazim vetarnegolin gedolim metappel bahen sheloshim yom. matza ketannim vechol davar shettippulo merubbe missecharo metappel bahen shelosha yamim. mikkan veelach mochran bevet din. vechen perot shehitchilu leharekiv vechayyotze bahen mochran bevet din: 
Ma yaase baddamim. yinnatnu lammotze veyesh lo reshut lehishtammesh bahen. lefichach im neensu kegon shetterafam gayis o tavu bayyam chayyav leshallem veaf al pi shello nishtammesh bahen shekkevan sheyyesh lo reshut lehishtammesh bahen hare hen etzlo kishela: 
Bamme devarim amurim bidme haaveda hoil venitpal bahen. aval meot aveda lo yishtammesh bahen. lefichach im avdu beones patur shehare hu shomer sachar kemo shebbearnu: 
Kol otan hayyamim shemmetappel baaveda kodem sheyyimkerenna bevet din im heechilam mishshello notel min habbealim. veyerae li shehu notel belo shevua mippene tikkun haolam: 
Hammotze metzia lo yishshava mippene tikkun haolam sheim atta omer yishshava yanniach hammetzia veyelech lo kede shello yishshava. afillu matza kis vetaan baal hammetzia sheshshene kisim keshurim hayu vei efshar sheyyimtza haechad ella im nimtza haacher hakkashur immo hare ze lo yishshava:

Hasimla bichlal <small>(Devarim 22 3)</small> "kol avedat achicha" hayta vechen hashshor vehasse vehachamor. velamma peret hakkatuv <small>(Devarim 22 3)</small> "chamor" lehacheziro besimane mirdaat af al pi shehassiman bedavar hattafel lo yachzir. velamma peret shor vese lehachezir afillu gizzat hasse o gez zenav shor af al pi shehu davar muat. velamma peret hassimla lilmod mimmenna ma hassimla meyuchedet sheyyesh lah simanin vechezkatah sheyyesh lah tovin vechayyav lehachezir af kol davar sheyyesh lo simanim hare hu bechezkat sheyyesh lo tovin vechayyav lehachezir. aval davar sheen lo tovin ella nityaashu mimmennu habbealim hare hu shel motzo af al pi sheyyesh bo simanim: 
Ze hakkelal baaveda kol davar sheen bo siman kevan sheavad veyadu bo habbealim sheavad hare ze bechezkat shennityaashu bealav mimmennu. kegon masmer echad o machat achat o matbea shehare enan yecholim litten siman lehacheziro lahen ulefichach hare hu laze shemmetzao: 
Vechol davar sheyyesh bo siman kegon simla uvehema hare ze bechezkat shello nityaashu mimmennu bealav shehare datan teluya litten simanin sheyyesh bo veyachzor lahen lefichach hammotzo chayyav lehacheriz ella im ken yada shennityaashu habbealim kegon sheshshama otam omrim vay lechesron kis vechayyotze bidvarim ellu shemmarin shennityaashu hare otah haaveda shel motzah: 
Vechen im matza davar sheyyesh bo siman bayyam uvannahar vechayyotze bahen o bemakom sherubbo akkum hare ze bechezkat shennityaashu bealav mimmennu mishshaa shennafal. ulefichach hare hu shel motzan veaf al pi shello shamu habbealim shennityaashu mimmennu: 
Yeush shello middaat afillu bedavar sheen bo siman eno yeush. ketzad. nafal mimmennu dinar velo yada bo shennafal af al pi shekkesheyyada bo shennafal yityaesh hare ze eno yeush atta ad sheyyedu habbealim shennafal. aval im adayin omrim habbealim shemma netattiv lifloni o bemigdal hu munnach o shemma taiti bacheshbon vechayyotze beellu haddevarim en ze yeush: 
Haroe chavero shennafal mimmennu dinar al haaretz velo yada bo venatal haddinar kodem yeush over al ase veal shene lavin kemo shebbearnu. vaafillu hechzir lo haddinar leachar shennityaesh mattana hi zo uchevar avar al haissurim: 
Natal haddinar lifne yeush al menat lehacheziro uleachar yeush nitkavven ligzol oto over mishshum <small>(Devarim 22 1)</small> "hashev teshivem". himtin lah velo hodia labbealim velo natal haddinar ad sheyyadu habbealim shennafal shehare nityaashu kemo shebbearnu veachar kach natal haddinar meal haaretz eno over ella mishshum <small>(Devarim 22 3)</small> "lo tuchal lehitallem". vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Raa sela o matbea shennafal afillu mishshelosha bene adam veaf al pi sheen bo sheve peruta lechol echad veechad chayyav lehachezir shemma shuttafin hen umachal echad mehen chelko lachavero venimtzet avedato shel ze sheve peruta: 
Raa chavero shennafal mimmennu dinar betoch hachol o betoch heafar venitallem mimmennu hare ze kenofel layyam o lannahar vahare hu shel motzo. shehare nityaesh mimmennu mippene sheen bo siman. vaafillu raa oto mevi kevara lechappes acharav. bedaat reua hu mechappes kederech shemmechappesim beafar shear habballashin shello nafal mehen kelum shemma yimtzeu ma shennafal laacherim kach hu ze mechappes lo mippene shello nityaesh: 
Hammotze sela bashshuk. metzao chavero veamar lo shelli hi vachadasha hi veshel medina pelonit hi veshel melech peloni hi. afillu amar shemi katuv aleha lo amar kelum veeno chayyav lehachezir. sheen simane hammatbea siman mippene shechezkato lehotzaa. veanu omrin shello hayta vehotziah miyyado venafla miyyad acher. vehoil veeno siman shessomchin alav mishsheat nefila nityaesh vahare hi shel motzah: 
Hammotze davar sheen bo siman betzad davar sheyyesh bo siman chayyav lehacheriz. ba baal hassiman venatal et shello veamar shezze bilvad nafal mimmennu zacha hammotze baddavar sheen bo siman: 
Hammotze kele cheres vechayyotze bahen mikkelim shetztzurat kullan shava. im kelim chadashim hen hare hem shello shehare hen kemo dinar mishshear haddinarim sheen lo siman veen habbealim makkirim otan. shehare eno yodea im pach ze o tzelochit zo shello o shel acher. veim hayu kelim shessevaatan haayin chayyav lehacheriz. sheim yavo talmid chacham veyomar af al pi sheeno yachol litten bichli kaze siman yesh li bo teviut ayin chayyav lehareoto lo, im hikkiro veamar shelli hu machazirin lo: 
Bamme devarim amurim betalmid vatik sheeno meshanne bedibburo kelal ella bedivre shalom o bemasechta o bemitta o bevayit shehu mitareach bo. ketzad. haya osek bemassechta denidda veamar bemikvaot ani shone kede shello yishaluhu sheelot beinyan nidda. o sheyyashan bemitta zo veomer bezo ani yashen shemma yimmatze sham keri. o shennitareach etzel shimon veamar etzel reuven ani mitareach kede shello yatriach al ze shennitareach etzlo. o shehevi shalom ben adam lachavero vehosif vegara kede lechabbevan ze laze hare ze muttar. aval im bau edim sheshshinna bedibburo chutz middevarim ellu en machazirin lo bitviut ayin:

Kol hammotze aveda ben sheyyesh bah siman ben shiin bah siman im metzaah derech hannacha asur ligga bah shemma bealeha hinnichuha sham ad sheyyachzeru lah veim yavo littelenna vehaya davar sheen bo siman hare ibbed mamon chavero beyado shehare en lo bah siman lehachezir bo. veim haya davar sheyyesh lo siman hare ze hitrichan lirdof achareha velatet simaneha. ulefichach asur lo sheyyigga bah ad sheyyimtzaenna derech nefila. vaafillu nistappek lo haddavar velo yada im davar ze avud o munnach hare ze lo yigga bo. veim avar unetalo asur lo lehacheziro lesham. veim haya davar sheen bo siman zacha bo veeno chayyav lehacheziro: 
Vechol davar sheyyesh bo siman ben bederech hannacha ben bederech nefila ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim chayyav lehacheriz. ketzad. derech hannacha kegon shemmatza chamor o para roim badderech bayyom o shemmatza keli mechusse baashpa hare ze lo yigga bahen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 1)</small> "niddachim badderech". aval im matza chamor vechelav hafuchim ufara ratza ben hakkeramim o keli megulle baashpa hare zo aveda venotel umachriz: 
Raa chamor o para roim baafar kedarkan ballayla hare zo aveda. bifnot hayyom uvanneshef im raa otan shelosha yamim ze achar ze hare zo aveda venotel umachriz. raa para ratza badderech im paneha kelappe hair en zo aveda. kelappe hassade hare zo aveda: 
Metzaah roa ben hakkeramim chayyav lehachezir mishshum avedat hakkarka. lefichach im hayu hakkeramim shel akkum enah aveda veeno chayyav lehachezir. veim chashash shemma yahargenna haakkum kesheyyimtzaenna mippene shehifsida hakkerem hare zo aveda venotel umachriz: 
Matza para birshut harabbim im omedet chutz lattechum chayyav lehachezir. hayta roa baasavim o shehayta berefet sheenah mishtammeret veenah meabbedet lo yigga bah sheen zo aveda. matza tallit o kardom betzad haggader hare ze lo yigga bahen. bisratya hare ze notel umachriz. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Matza gozalot mekushsharin bechanfehen umedaddin achar haggader o achar haggappa o bashshevilin shebbassadot hare ze lo yigga bahen shemma baalehen hinnichum sham. veim netalan hare ellu shello. veim hayu keshurin kesher shehu siman chayyav lehacheriz. vechen im metzaan kevuim bimkoman chayyav lehacheriz shehammakom siman: 
Matza baashpa keli mechusse hare ze lo yigga bo kemo shebbearnu. veim ashpa sheenah asuya lehitpannot hi venimlach aleha lefannotah af al pi shemmetzao mechusse notel umachriz. vechen im hayu kelim ketannim kegon sakkin veshippud vechayyotze bahen afillu hayu mechussin baashpa hakkevua notel umachriz: 
Matza perot mefuzzarin derech hannacha lo yigga bahen. derech nefila hare hen shello. vechen im matza kerichot ketannot shel shibbolim birshut harabbim shehare en bahen siman. o shemmatza iggule devela vechikkarot shel nachtom umachrozot shel dagim vachatichot shel basar vegizze tzemer habbaot mimmedinatan vaanitze pishtan uleshonot shel argaman hare ellu shello mippene sheen bahen siman. veim yesh bahen siman notel umachriz shessiman heasuy liddares hare hu siman: 
Aval im matza kikkarot shel baal habbayit vegizze tzemer hallekuchot mibbet haumman kadde yayin vechadde shemen chayyav lehacheriz shekkol ellu yesh lahem simanin muvhakin. veim niftechu haotzarot shel yayin veshel shemen hare ellu shello. veaf al pi shehem reshumin. shekkol hakkaddot kach hayu reshumot venimtzeu ellu hakkaddin kechikkerot hannachtom sheyyesh tzura achat lechullan umishkal echad lechullam: 
Matza kerichot birshut hayyachid im derech nefila hare ellu shello. veim derech hannacha chayyav lehacheriz sheaf al pi sheen lahem siman hammakom siman (af al pi sheeno siman muvhak). matza alummot ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim notel umachriz: 
Matza iggul uvetocho cheres. kikkar uvetocho maot. chaticha shel basar shehu meshunne bachatichot. dag nashuch. vechen kol kayyotze beellu hoil veyesh bahen shinnuy chayyav lehacheriz. shello asaum baalehen ella lesiman: 
Matza perot mefuzzarin bemakom haggoranot im hayu kemo kav betoch arba ammot o beyeter al arba ammot hare ellu shello mippene sheen habbealim metappelim baasifatan. hayu mefuzzarin befachot mearba ammot lo yigga bahen shemma habbealim hinnichum sham. hayu kemo chatzi kav bishte ammot o kabbayim bishmone ammot o shehaya hakkav mishshenayim ushelosha minin kemo temarim shumshemin [verimmonim] kol ellu safek lefichach lo yittol. veim natal eno chayyav lehacheriz: 
Hammotze tzibbure perot o perot bichli o keli kemot shehu chayyav lehacheriz. matza keli ulefanav perot hare ellu shello happerot. vehakkeli notel umachriz. sheani omer hakkeli shel echad vehapperot shel acher vahare en bo siman. veim marin haddevarim shehen shel adam echad chayyav lehacheriz: 
Ketzad. hayu achore hakkeli lifne happerot hare ellu shello. hayu pene hakkeli lifne happerot choshshin shemma min hakkeli nishpechu. veim hayu oggonim lakkeli af al pi sheppanav kelappe happerot hare ellu shello sheillu nishpechu min hakkeli haya nishar mehen betocho mippene haoggonim. hayu miktzat happerot bakkeli umiktzatan baaretz chayyav lehacheriz: 
Hammotze ketziot badderech vaafillu betzad sede ketziot hare ellu shello. vechen teena shehi nota ladderech venimtzeu teenim tachteha muttarot mishshum gezel. shehatteena vechayyotze bah im nefilatah nimeset. ufeturot mishshum maaser. aval zetim vecharuvin vechayyotze bahen asurin: 
Temarim shemmeshiran haruach muttarot shehabbealim mechalum lechol adam vezo hi chezkatan. veim hayu shel yetomim sheenan bene mechila asurin. vechen im hikpid baal hassade vehikkif mekom hailanot o tikken makom sheyyippelu bo hannovlot ad sheyyelakketem hare ellu asurot shehare gilla dato shello machal: 
Chatul ra shehoreg et hakketannim asur lekayyemo veen bo mishshum gezel veen bo mishshum heshshev aveda af al pi sheoro moil ella kol hammotzo zacha bo vehorgo vehaor shello: 
Gozal hannimtza karov lashshovach betoch chamishshim amma hare hu shel baal hashshovach chutz lachamishshim amma hare hu shel motzo sheen haggozal medadde yeter al chamishshim amma. nimtza ben shene shovachot hare hu shel karov. mechetza lemechetza yachaloku. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu yone shete hashshovachot shavim beminyan. aval im hayu yone haechad rabbim hallech achar harov af al pi shehu rachok:

Hammotze mechatim vetzinnorot umasmerim vechayyotzo bahen im metzaam echad echad hare ellu shello. shenayim shenayim o yeter chayyav lehacheriz shemminyan siman: 
Vechen hammotze maot mefuzzarim hare ellu shello. afillu hayu miktzat matbeot ze al gabbe ze hare hen kimfuzzarin. aval im matza tzibbur maot chayyav lehacheriz. matza shelosha matbeot ze al gav ze vehen asuyin kemigdal. o shehayu echad mikkan veechad mikkan veechad al gabbehen. o shehayu miktzat ze al miktzat ze kede sheim yachnis kesam benehen yinnatlu bevat achat chayyav lehacheriz. hayu asuyim keshir o keshura o kachatzuva o kesullam hare ze safek velo yittol: 
Hammotze maot bakkis o kis kemot shehu chayyav lehacheriz. matza kis ulefanav maot mefuzzarim hare ellu shello. veim marin haddevarim shehakkis vehammaot shel adam echad umin hakkis naflu chayyav lehacheriz: 
Hammotze maot bachanut im hayu ben teva lachenvani hare hen shel baal hachanut. veim metzaan al hatteva veen tzarich lomar mitteva velachutz hare hen shel motzan. velamma lo tikne hachanut livaleha lefi sheenah chatzer hammishtammeret. veaf al pi shebbealeha betochah tzarich lomar tikne li chanuti kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Matza maot bachanut hashshulchani ben kisse lashshulchani hare ellu shel shulchani. metzaan al hakkisse lifne hashshulchani afillu hayu tzerurin umunnachin al hashshulchan hare ellu shel motzan. vehu sheyyihyu rov akkum kemo shebbearnu. aval im hayu rov yisrael chayyav lehacheriz. mippene shehen tzerurim yesh lahem siman: 
Hallokeach perot mechavero o sheshshalach lo chavero perot umatza betochan maot tzerurot notel umachriz. metzaan mefuzzarot hare ellu shello. bamme devarim amurim beshehayu happerot min hattaggar o mibbaal habbayit shellekachan min hattaggar. aval im baal habbayit dash happerot leatzmo o al yede avadav veshifchotav hakkenaanim hare ze chayyav lehachezir: 
Hammotze matmon begal o bechotel yashan hare ellu shello sheani omer shel emoriyyim hakkadmonim hen. vehu sheyyimtzaem matta matta kederech kol hammatmonot hayeshanot. aval im marin haddevarim shehen matmon chadash afillu nistappek lo haddavar hare ze lo yigga bahen shemma munnachim hem sham: 
Vehoil vachatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato kemo sheyyitbaer lamma lo yikne baal hechatzer ze hammatmon shebbetoch hakkotel hayyashan af al pi shehu shel emoriyyim vetihye metzia zo levaal hechatzer. mippene sheeno yadua lo velo laacherim vahare ze hammatmon avud mimmennu umikkol adam ulefichach hu shel motzo. uma aveda shel adam amra tora <small>(Devarim 22 3)</small> "asher tovad mimmennu umetzatah" mi sheavuda mimmennu umetzuya etzel kol adam yatzat zo shennafla layyam sheavuda mimmennu umikkol adam kal vachomer lematmon kadmoni shello haya shello meolam vehu avud mimmennu umikkol adam lefichach hu shel motzo: 
Matza matmon bechotel chadash im hammatmon mochiach shehu levaal habbayit hare hu shello veim mochiach shehu shel acher min hashshuk hare hu shel motzo. ketzad. hassakkin hare hannitztzav shello mochiach. vehakkis piv mochiach. veim nimtza toch hakkotel male mehen cholkin: 
Hayu betoch hakkotel maot o leshonot shel zahav sheen sham mochiach. mechetzyo velachutz shel motze. mechetzyo ulefanim shel baal habbayit: 
Veyerae li sheen haddevarim amurim ella keshettaan baal habbayit shehammatmon shello. o shehaya yoresh sheanu toanin lo shemma shel aviv hen. aval im hoda shehen metzia hare hen shel motze. lefichach im haya maskir beto laacherim hare hen shel socher acharon. veim hiskiro lishlosha akkum keechad hare asaahu pundak vechol hannimtza bo afillu betoch habbayit hare hu shel motzan mippene sheen echad yachol liton shehen shello o shehu taman shehare asaahu pundak:

Kol metzia sheamarnu bah shehi shel motzah eno zoche bah ad shettaggia leyado o lirshuto. aval im raa et hammetzia afillu nafal aleha uva acher vehechezik bah hare ze shehechzik bah zacha bah: 
Haya rochev al gabbe behema veraa et hammetzia veamar lachavero zeche li bah kevan shehigbihah lo kana harochev veaf al pi shello higgia leyado. veim amar lo tena li unetalah veamar ani zachiti bah zacha bah hannotel. veim mishshennetanah larochev amar ani zachiti bah techilla lo amar kelum: 
Hammagbiah metzia lachavero kana chavero veaf al pi shello amar lo kelum [zacha bah]. higbihu hammetzia shenayim kenauha shenehem: 
Higbihah lo cheresh o shote o katan lo kana happikkeach lefi sheen lahen daat. higbihah cheresh ufikkeach keechad mittoch shello kana pikkeach lo kana cheresh. hayu shenehem chershim tikkenu chachamim sheyyiknu kede shello yavou lehinnatzot: 
Shenayim sherau gamal o chamor shel metzia vekadmu shenehem vehinhiguhu o meshachuhu. o shehaya echad manhig veechad moshech. kanu shenehem. bamme devarim amurim bachamor aval begamal im haya echad manhig veechad moshech hammoshech kana aval lo hammanhig: 
Behemat metzia shekkadam echad veachaz bammosera lo kana ad sheyyimshoch o yanhig. vechen benichse hagger. aval kana hammosera levaddah: 
Haya echad rochev veechad ochez bammosera harochev kana habbehema vehammosera sheal lechaye habbehema bilvad. veze sheachaz hammosera kana mimmenna ma sheachaz beyado. ushear hammosera lo kanahu echad mehen: 
Chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato. veim nafla bah metzia hare hi shel baal hechatzer. bamme devarim amurim bechatzer hammishtammeret. aval besade veginna vechayyotze bahen im haya omed betzad sadehu veamar zachta li sadi zacha bah. veim eno omed sham o shehaya omed velo amar zachta li sadi kol hakkodem zacha. vechen arba ammot shel adam shehu omed betziddan hare ellu konim lo. veim higgia hammetzia letoch arba ammot shello zacha bah: 
Chachamim tikkenu davar ze kede shello yarivu hammotzin ze im ze. bamme devarim amurim besimta o betzidde reshut harabbim sheen harabbim dochakin bahen o besade sheen lo bealim. aval haomed birshut harabbim o betoch sede chavero en arba ammot konot lo veeno kone sham ad shettaggia metzia leyado: 
Ketanna yesh lah chatzer veyesh lah arba ammot. vekatan en lo chatzer veen lo arba ammot. mippene shechatzer shel ketanna miyyadah lemadnuha. shekkeshem shehi mitgareshet beget hammaggia leyadah kach mitgareshet beget hammaggia lachatzerah. ucheshem sheyyesh lah chatzer leinyan hagget kach yesh lah leinyan metzia. vearba ammot shel adam kachatzero leinyan metzia. aval haish lamadnu shechatzero kona lo mishshelucho. kederech shekkone lo shelucho kach tikne lo chatzero. vehakkatan hoil veeno ose shaliach kach en chatzero velo arba ammot shello konin lo ad shettaggia metzia leyado: 
Mi sheraa acherim ratzim achar hammetzia vahare hi tzevi shavur o gozalot shello parchu. im haya omed betzad sadehu shehen betochah veillu haya ratz haya maggian veamar zachta li sadi zachta lo sadehu. veim eno yachol lehaggian hare ellu kitzvi shehu ratz kedarko uchegozalot hammafrichim velo amar kelum ella kol hakkodem bahen zacha. veim nittenu lo bemattana hoil veacher hiknam lo vahare hen mitgalgelin betoch sadehu kanta lo sadehu veim haya tzevi ratz kedarko vegozalot mafrichin lo kanta lo sadehu: 
Metziat cheresh shote vekatan yesh bah gezel mippene darche shalom. lefichach im avar acher ugezalah miyyadan enah yotza bedayyanim. veim kafar bah venishba eno chayyav bechomesh: 
Metziat beno uvitto hassemuchim al shulchano af al pi shehen gedolim umetziat bitto hannaara af al pi sheenah somechet al shulchano vaafillu hayta mechura amma umetziat avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim umetziat ishto hare ellu shello. aval metziat beno sheeno somech al shulchano af al pi shehu katan umetziat avdo veshifchato haivrim umetziat ishto shehi megoreshet veenah megoreshet kol ellu hammetziot enan shello:

Hammotze shetar chov af al pi shello peresh bo acharayut nechasim veaf al pi shehachayyav mode veaf al pi shehu mekuyyam hare ze lo yachzir. shemma perao ukenuneya hem osim kede litrof lakochot shello kaddin ulefichach hoda lo shehare yesh lo litrof bishtar shello peresh bo acharayut. shehaacharayut shello nitparsha taut sofer hu ben beshitre halevaa ben beshitre mikkach umimkar. lefichach im peresh bishtar ze shehu shello beacharayut im haya hachayyav mode yachzir veim lav lo yachzir shemma perao:
Vechen im matza shetar shezzemanno bo bayyom vehaya mekuyyam vehachayyav mode yachzir. veim eno mekuyyam lo yachzir shemma katav lilvot vaadayin lo lava:

Matza shetar bechemet o bichli etz vechayyotze bahen hare ze yachzir lemi shennatan siman. matza shelosha shetarot keruchin becherech echad o munnachin ze al ze vaagudim eged echad yachzir lemi shennatan siman:

Haya hallo echad vehammalvim shelosha im mekuyyamim hem yachzir lallo. veim lav yachzir lemi shennatan siman shemma hammalvim natnu shetarotehen lassofer lekayyeman venaflu miyyad haddayyan. haya hammalve echad vehallovim shelosha yachzir lammalve. veim hayu shelashtan bichtav yede sofer echad yachzir lemi shennatan siman. shemma shelashtan holichu shitrehen lassofer lichtov venaflu miyyad hassofer:

Matza shetarot keruin ushetar chov benehen lo yachzir. veim yesh immahen shover afillu belo edim yitten shetar hachov lallo. sheillu lo haya parua lo hishlicho ben shetarot keruim vahare yesh immo ketav shehu parua:

Matza gitte nashim bizman shehabbaal mode yachzir laishsha. en habbaal mode im natna haishsha siman muvhak yinnaten lah veim lav lo yachzir lo laze velo laze. amar habbaal miyyadi nafal venatan simanav vehaishsha omeret miyyadi nafal venatna simanav yinnaten lah. vehu shettitten siman muvhak kegon sheamra nekev yesh betzad ot pelonit. sheillu lo higgia leyadah lo hayta yodaat:

Hu omer simane hachut shekkashar bo hagget vehi omeret simane hachut yinnaten lah. vehu shettomar siman muvhak kegon orech middat hachut. aval im amra adom o shachor hu en ze siman muvhak. hu omer bechemet haya munnach vehi omeret bechemet haya munnach yinnaten lo sheen ze siman muvhak:
Matza get shichrur bizman sheharav mode yachzir laeved. en harav mode lo yachzir lo laze velo laze:

Matza shetar mattana im mattenat bari hi af al pi sheshshenehem modim lo yachzir lo laze velo laze. shemma katav litten velo natan veachar shekkatav shetar ze machar sade zo o netanah leacher bemattana vechazar bo. veze shemmode laze kede laasot kenuneya al haacharon shennatan lo o shemmachar lo. veim mattenat shechiv mera hi im hoda yitten veim lav lo yitten. sheshshechiv mera shennatan lishnayim ze achar ze haacharon kana kemo sheyyitbaer:

Met shechiv mera shennetanah bemattana af al pi shehayyoresh mode shemmorisho netanah hare ze lo yachzir lo laze velo laze. shemma katav litten velo natan umecharah hayyoresh o netanah vechazar bo vahare hu rotze laasot kenuneya im ze kede lehafekia nichse ze haacharon:
Matza shover bizman shebbaal hashshetar mode shennishbar shetaro uferao o mechalo yitten levaal hashshover. en shenehem modim lo yachzir lo laze velo laze:
Matza ketubba af al pi sheshshenehem modim lo yachzir laishsha shemma nifrea ketubba zo o nimchala veachar kach machar habbaal nechasav vahare hu rotze laasot kenuneya al hallakochot:

Matza iggerot shum veiggerot mazon shitre chalitza umeunin veshitre teanot shekkotvin haddayyanin shel baal din ze veshel chavero. o shemmatza shitre berurim vehem hashshetarot shebberru lahen baale dinin et haddayyanin sheddanin lahem vekibbelu alehem sheyyadunu lahem peloni ufeloni. o shemmatza kol maase bet din. hare ze yachzir. kelalo shel davar kol shetar shechoshshin bo leferaon lo yachzir shemma nifra hachov. veim haya hachayyav mode veefshar shehoda kede laasot kenuneya ad sheyyafsid et hallokeach o mekabbel mattana shellekacho achar zeman hashshetar kede sheyyifreu miyyadam shello kaddin hare ze lo yachzir af al pi sheshshenehem modim. vechol shetar sheen bo tzad lachashash lo leferaon velo liknuneya yachzir livalav:

Kol hashshetarot hannimtzaim sheddinan shello yachzir im hechzir hare ellu kesherim vegovin bahen veen motziin otan mittachat yad baalehen vahare hem bechezkatan veen choshshin lahem: seliku lehu hilchot gezela vaaveda besad
Mishneh Torah, One Who Injures a Person: Hachovel bachavero chayyav leshallem lo chamishsha devarim veellu hem. nezek vetzaar verippuy veshevet uvoshet. vachamishsha devarim ellu kullan mishtallemim min hayyafe shebbinchasav kedin kol hammazzikin:

Nezek ketzad. sheim kata yad chavero o raglo roin oto keillu hu eved nimkar bashshuk kamma haya yafe [az] vechamma hu yafe atta umeshallem happechat shehifchit middamav. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 24)</small> <small>(Vayikra 24 20)</small> "ayin tachat ayin". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar tachat leshallem mamon hu:

Ze shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 24 20)</small> "kaasher yitten mum baadam ken yinnaten bo" eno lachavol baze kemo shechaval bachavero ella shehu rauy lechassero evar o lachavol bo kaasher asa ulefichach meshallem nizko. vahare hu omer <small>(Bamidbar la lo)</small> "velo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach" lerotzeach bilvad hu sheen bo kofer aval lechesron evarim o lechabbalot yesh bo kofer:

Vechen ze shenneemar bechovel bachavero umazziko <small>(Devarim 25 12)</small> "lo tachos enecha" shello tachus betashlumin shemma tomar ani hu ze veshello bechavvana chaval bo arachamennu lechach neemar lo tachos enecha:

Uminnayin shezze shenneemar beevarim <small>(Shemot 21 24)</small> <small>(Vayikra 24 20)</small> "ayin tachat ayin" tashlumin hu. shenneemar bo <small>(Shemot 21 25)</small> "chabbura tachat chabbura" uveferush neemar <small>(Shemot 21 18)</small> "vechi yakke ish et reehu beeven o beegrof" vegomer <small>(Shemot 21 19)</small> "rak shivto yitten verappo yerappe". ha lamadta shettachat shenneemar bechabbura tashlumin. vehu haddin letachat haamur beayin uvishar evarim:

Veaf al pi sheddevarim ellu nirim meinyan tora shebbichtav vechullan meforashin hen mippi moshe rabbenu mehar sinay. kullan halacha lemoshe hen beyadenu vechaze rau avotenu danin bevet dino shel yehoshua uvevet dino shel shemuel haramati uvechol bet din uvet din sheamdu mimot moshe rabbenu vead achshav:

Uminnayin shemmazzik bachavero chayyav betzaar bifne atzmo. shehare neemar beones <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "tachat asher innah". vehu haddin lechol hametzaer et chavero begufo shehu chayyav leshallem deme hatztzaar:
Uminnayin shehu chayyav beshevet bifne atzmo verippuy bifne atzmo. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 19)</small> "rak shivto yitten verappo yerappe":

Uminnayin shehu chayyav bevoshet bifne atzmo shehare neemar <small>(Devarim 25 11)</small> "veshalcha yadah vehechezika bimvushav" <small>(Devarim 25 12)</small> "vekatztzota et kappah" bichlal din ze kol hamevayyesh:

Hamevayyesh eno chayyav al habboshet ad sheyyihye mitkavven shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 11)</small> "veshalcha yadah". aval hamevayyesh chavero belo kavvana patur. lefichach yashen vechayyotze bo shebbiyyesh patur:

Adam muad leolam ben shogeg ben mezid ben er ben yashen ben shikkor im chaval bachavero o hizzik mamon chavero meshallem min hayyafe shebbinchasav. bamme devarim amurim shehayyashen chayyav leshallem bishnayim sheyyashnu keechad venithappech echad mehen vehizzik et chavero o kara bigdo. aval im haya echad yashen uva acher veshachav betziddo. ze shebba baacharona hu hammuad veim hizziko hayyashen patur. vechen im hinniach keli betzad hayyashen ushevaro patur shezze shehinnicho hu hammuad sheppasha:

Mi shennafal min haggag beruach metzuya vehizzik chayyav bearbaa devarim ufatur min habboshet. nafal beruach sheenah metzuya chayyav benezek bilvad ufatur mearbaa devarim. veim nithappech chayyav bakkol af bevoshet shekkol hammitkavven lehazzik af al pi shello nitkavven levayyesh chayyav bevoshet:
Shenayim shechavlu beechad keechad shenehem chayyavin umeshalleshin benehen. haya echad mitkavven veechad sheeno mitkavven ze sheeno mitkavven patur min habboshet:
Hammitkavven levayyesh et hakkatan uviyyesh et haggadol noten laggadol deme bashto shel katan. nitkavven levayyesh haeved uviyyesh et ben chorin noten leven chorin deme bashto shel eved:

Hayta lo even munnachat becheko ben shello hikkir bah meolam ben shehikkir bah ushechachah veamad venafla vehizzika chayyav benezek bilvad ufatur mearbaa devarim. vechen im nitkavven lizrok shetayim vezarak arba vehizzik o shehizzik keshehu yashen chayyav benezek ufatur mearbaa devarim:

Hammazzik et chavero bechavvana bechol makom chayyav bachamishsha devarim. vaafillu nichnas lirshut chavero shello birshut vehizziko baal habbayit chayyav sheyyesh lo reshut lehotzio veen lo reshut lehazziko. aval im huzzak ze shennichnas bevaal habbayit hare baal habbayit patur. veim huzzak bo baal habbayit chayyav mippene shennichnas shello birshut. hayu shenehem birshut o shenehem shello birshut vehuzzeku ze baze shenehem peturin:

Hamevakkea etzim birshut harabbim ufarach etz mehen vehizzik birshut hayyachid. o shebbikkea birshut hayyachid vehizzik birshut harabbim. o shebbikkea birshut hayyachid vehizzik birshut hayyachid acher. o shennichnas lachanuto shel naggar ben birshut ben shello birshut venitteza bekaat vetafcha al panav. bechol ellu chayyav bearbaa devarim ufatur min habboshet:

Keshem sheomdin lemita kach omdin linzakin. ketzad. hare shehikka chavero bitzror katan sheen bo kede lehazzik o bekesam shel etz katan vechaval bo chabbala sheen chefetz ze rauy laasoto hare ze patur. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 18)</small> "beeven o veegrof" davar harauy lehazzik. aval chayyav hu bevoshet bilvad. afillu rakak begufo shel chavero chayyav bevoshet. lefichach tzerichin haedim leda bema hizzik umeviin hachefetz shehizzik bo levet din ad sheomdin oto vedanin alav. veim avad hachefetz veamar hachovel lo haya bo kede lehazzik uchemo anus ani. vehannechbal omer haya bo kede lehazzik. yishshava hannechbal veyittol kemo sheyyitbaer:

Habbarzel en lo omed afillu machat ketanna reuya hi lehamit veen tzarich lomar lehazzik. hazzorek even uleachar sheyyatza mittachat yado hotzi halla et rosho min hachallon vekibbelah patur mikkelum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 5)</small> "umatza et reehu" perat lemamtzi et atzmo:

Hachovel bachavero chabbala shehu rauy leshallem hachamishsha devarim kullam meshallem chamishsha. hizziko nezek sheen bo ella arbaa meshallem arbaa. shelosha meshallem shelosha. shenayim meshallem shenayim. echad meshallem echad: 
Ketzad. kata yado o raglo o etzba mehen o shessimme eno meshallem chamishsha nezek vetzaar verippuy veshevet uvoshet. hikkahu al yado vetzavta vesofah lachzor. al eno umarda vesofah lichyot. meshallem arbaa tzaar verippuy veshevet uvoshet. hikkahu al rosho vetzava meshallem shelosha tzaar verippuy uvoshet. hikkahu bemakom sheeno nire kegon shehikka al birkav o begabbo meshallem shenayim tzaar verippuy. hikkahu bemitpachat shebbeyado o bishtar vechayyotze beellu noten achat vehi habboshet bilvad: 
Kevaahu beshippud o bemasmer al tzipparnav bemakom sheeno ose chabbura velo meakkev melacha meshallem hatztzaar bilvad. hishkahu sam o sacho sam veshinna mare oro meshallem lo rippuy bilvad ad sheyyachazor marehu keshehaya. asaro becheder noten lo deme shevet bilvad. vechen kol kayyotze beellu: 
Hamegalleach sear rosh chavero noten lo deme bashto bilvad mippene shessofo lachzor. gillecho besam o shekkevaahu ad sheen sof hassear lachzor chayyav bachamishsha devarim. benezek betzaar verippuy shehare yitchammem rosho min hakkeviyya o min hassam venimtza chash berosho. umeshallem lo shevet shehare hu rauy lirkod ulenadned delet rosho bishat rikkud venimtza batel mimmelacha zo. uvoshet sheen lecha boshet gadol mizze: 
Ha lamadta shekkol hamechasser chavero evar sheeno chozer chayyav bechol hachamishsha devarim. afillu hippil shinno chayyav bakkol shei efshar shello yechele piv shaa achat. af al pi shehashshen en lo refua besar hashshinnayim tzarich refua: 
Afillu chissero kesaara meor besaro chayyav bachamishsha devarim. shehaor eno chozer ella tzalleket. lefichach hachovel bachavero vekara haor vehotzi mimmennu dam chayyav bachamishsha devarim: 
Hammavit chavero af al pi shechala min happachad hare ze patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. vehu shello naga bo ella kegon shetztzaak meachorav o shennitraa [lo] baafela vechayyotze baze. vechen im tzaak beazno vechersho patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. achazo vetaka beazno vechersho o shennaga bo udechafo beet shehivito o sheachaz bivgadav vechayyotze bidvarim ellu chayyav betashlumin: 
Yerae li shehannechbal sheamar nitcharashti o nismet eni vahare eni roe o eni shomea eno neeman. shehare en anu makkirin haddavar shemma yaarim. veeno notel hannezek ad sheyyibbadek zeman merubbe veyihye muchzak sheavad meor enav o nitcharesh veachar kach yeshallem ze: 
Kamma hu hatztzaar. hakkol hu lefi hannizzak. yesh adam shehu rach veanog meod uvaal mamon veillu natnu lo mamon harebe lo haya mitztaer meat. veyesh adam shehu amlan vechazak veani umippene zuz echad mitztaer tzaar harebe. veal pi haddevarim haelle omdin ufoskin hatztzaar: 
Ketzad meshaarin hatztzaar bemakom shechissero evar. hare shekkata yado o etzbao omdim kamma adam kaze rotze litten ben liktoa lo evar ze besayif o liktoa oto besam im gazar alav hammelech liktoa yado o raglo. veomdin kamma yesh ben ze laze umeshallem hammazzik: 
Ketzad meshaarin hashshevet. im lo chissero evar ella chala venafal lemishkav o shetztzavta yado vesofah lachzor noten lo deme shivto shel kol yom veyom kefoel batel shel otah melacha shebbittel mimmennu. veim chissero evar o shekkata yado noten deme yado shehu hannezek. veshevet roin oto keillu hu shomer kishshuim veroin kamma hu sechar shomer kishshuin bechol yom veosin cheshbon kol yeme chalyo shel ze venoten lo. vechen im kata raglo roin oto keillu hu shomer al happetach. simme eno roin oto keillu hu tochen berechayim. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hikka et chavero al azno o achazo vetaka beazno vechersho noten lo deme kullo shehare eno rauy limlacha kelal: 
Simme et eno velo amaduhu kata et yado velo amaduhu vekata et raglo velo amaduhu veachar kach chersho hoil velo amaduhu lechol nezek venezek noten lo deme kullo. amaduhu lechol nezek venezek veachar kach amaduhu lechullo en govin mimmennu ella deme kullo bilvad. veim tafas hannizzak nezek kol evar veevar udeme kullo en motziin miyyado: 
Ketzad meshaarin harippuy. omdin kamma yamim yichye ze mecholi ze vechamma hu tzarich venoten lo miyyad. veen mechayyevin oto litten devar yom beyomo. vedavar ze takkana hi lammazzik: 
Vechen hashshevet omdin otah venoten hakkol miyyad. im haya mitgalgel bechalyo veholech vearach bo hacholi yeter al ma sheamaduhu eno mosif lo kelum. vechen im hivri miyyad en pochatin lo mimma sheamaduhu: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheratza hammazzik shezzo takkana hi lo. aval im amar hammazzik en retzoni betakkana zo ella arappeennu devar yom beyomo shomin lo: 
Amar lo hannizzak pesok immi veten al yadi vaani arappe et atzmi en shomin lo shehare omer lo shemma lo terappe atzmecha veechezak ani kemazzik ella noten lo devar yom beyomo. o posek al hakkol venoten deme harippuy al yede bet din: 
Amar lo hammazzik ani arappe otcha o yesh li rofe shemmerappe bechinnam en shomin lo ella mevi rofe umman umerappeehu besachar: 
Hare shello pasak immo ella haya merappe yom veyom vealu bo tzemachim mechamat hammakka o nistera hammakka achar shechayta. chayyav lerappeoto velatet lo deme shivto. alu bo tzemachim shello mechamat hammakka chayyav lerappeoto veeno noten lo deme shivto. avar al divre rofe vehichbid alav hacholi eno chayyav lerappeoto: 
Keshepposkin bet din al hammazzik umechayyevin oto leshallem govin mimmennu hakkol miyyad veen kovin lo zeman kelal. veim nitchayyev bevoshet bilvad kovin lo zeman leshallem shehare lo chissero mamon:

Ketzad meshaarin habboshet. hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh. eno dome mitbayyesh min hakkatan lemitbayyesh meadam gadol umechubbad shezze shebbiyyesho ze hakkal bashto merubba: 
Hamevayyesh et hearom o mi shehu bemerchatz patur. nashva haruach vehafcha shulav al panav vahare hu arom vehosif ze behafeshatato chayyav bevoshet. veeno dome mevayyesh et ze shennaasa arom limvayyesh et sheeno arom. vechen im higbiah begadav lered lannahar o sheala min hannahar uviyyesho chayyav. veeno dome mevayyesh ze limvayyesh et hamechusse bivgadav: 
Hamevayyesh et hayyashen chayyav bevoshet. veim met betoch shenato velo hekitz velo hirgish baze shebbiyyesho en govin boshet ze min hamevayyesh. veim tafsu hayyorshin en motziin miyyadan:
