Hamevayyesh et hashshote patur. vehamevayyesh et hacheresh chayyav. hamevayyesh et hagger o et haeved chayyav. hamevayyesh et hakkatan im keshemmachlimin oto nichlam chayyav veim lav patur. umikkol makom eno dome hamevayyesh et hakkatan limvayyesh et haggadol. velo hamevayyesh et haeved limvayyesh et ben chorin. velo mevayyesh cheresh limvayyesh pikkeach: 
Hamevayyesh et chavero bidvarim o sherakak al begadav patur min hattashlumin. veyesh levet din ligdor baddavar bechol makom uvechol zeman kefi sheyyiru. veim biyyesh talmid chachamim chayyav leshallem lo boshet shelema af al pi shello biyyesho ella bidvarim. kevar nifsak haddin shekkol hamevayyesh talmid chacham afillu bidvarim konsin oto vegovin mimmennu mishkal sheloshim vachamishsha dinar min hazzahav shehu mishkal tesha selaim pachot revia. vekabbala hi beyadenu sheggovin kenas ze bechol makom ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz: 
Maasim hayu etzlenu tamid bechach bisfarad. veyesh talmide chachamim shehayu mochalin al ze vechach nae lahem. veyesh shettovea veosin peshara benehen. aval haddayyanim hayu omrin lamvayyesh chayyav atta litten lo litra zahav: 
Af al pi shehamevayyesh shear haam bidvarim patur min hattashlumin avon gadol hu. veeno mecharef umegaddef laam ella rasha shote. veamru chachamim harishonim shekkol hammalbin pene adam kasher miyyisrael bidvarim en lo chelek laolam habba: 
Yesh hakkaot rabbot sheyyesh bahen bizzuy vetzaar meat veen bahen nezek. uchevar pasku lahem chachamim damim ketzuvim. vechol hammakke lachavero hakkaa mehen meshallem oto hammamon hakkatzuv vechullan kenasot hen. veoto hammamon hakkatzuv hu deme hatztzaar vehabboshet veharippuy vehashshevet. ben tzarich lirfua veshevet ben lo tzarich kaze hu meshallem: 
Vechamma hu meshallem. habboet bachavero beraglo meshallem chamesh selaim. hikkahu bearkubbato meshallem shalosh selaim. kibbetz etzbeotav kemo oged aguda vehikkahu beyado keshehi aguda meshallem shelosh esre selaim. taka et chavero bechappo meshallem sela. setaro al panav meshallem chamishshim selaim. setaro meachore yado meshallem mea sela. vechen im tzirem beazno o talash bisaro o sherakak vehiggio [harok bivsaro o heevir tallit mealav ufara rosh haishsha] meshallem mea sela. vechaze hu meshallem al kol maase umaase. ketzad. kegon shebbaat bachavero arba beitot afillu zo achar zo meshallem esrim selaim. setaro al panav shete setirot meshallem mea sela. vechen bashshear: 
Kol ellu hasselaim hem mikkesef eretz yisrael beoto hazzeman. shehaya bechol sela chatzi dinar kesef ushelosha dinarin umechetza nechoshet. lefichach mi shennitchayyev behakkaot ellu leshallem mea sela hare ze meshallem shetem esre sela umechetza kesef naki: 
Bamme devarim amurim bimchubbad. aval adam shehu mevuzze veeno makpid bechol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen eno notel ella lefi ma sherauy lo uchemo sheyyiru haddayyanim shehu rauy littol. lefi sheyyesh bene adam keurin sheen makpidin al bashtam vechol hayyom mevazzim atzman bechol mine bizzuy derech sechok vekallut rosh o kede littol peruta achat min halletzim hamesachakim immahem:

Hannogef et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha af al pi shello nitkavven chayyav leshallem deme veladot labbaal venezek vetzaar laishsha: 
Vechetzad meshaarin deme veladot. shamin haishsha kamma hayta yafa ad shello yalda vechamma hi yafa mishsheyyalda venotnin labbaal. im met habbaal notnin leyorshav. veim niggefa achar mitat habbaal notnin af deme veladot laishsha: 
Hayta nesua leger vechaval bah bechayye hagger noten deme veladot labbaal. met hagger patur. veim chaval bah achar mitat hagger zachta hi bidme veladot: 
Hayta shifcha o akkum bishat herayon uvishat negifa nishtachrera o nitgayyera hare deme havveladot shellah: 
Hannogef et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha umeta af al pi shehaya shogeg hare ze patur min hattashlumin veeno meshallem kelum. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 22)</small> "velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh". lo chillek hakkatuv ben shogeg lemezid bedavar sheyyesh bo mitat bet din lefatro min hattashlumin: 
Bamme devarim amurim shennitkavven laishsha. aval im nitkavven lachavero venagaf et haishsha af al pi shemmeta hoil vehemitah belo kavvana hare ze kedavar sheen bo mitat bet din umeshallem deme veladot: 
Hammakke aviv veimmo velo asa bahen chabbura chayyav bachamishsha devarim. aval im asa bahem chabbura o shechaval bachavero beshabbat afillu haya shogeg patur min hattashlumin mippene shehu avon mitat bet din. uchevar bearnu shello chillek hakkatuv bedavar sheyyesh bo mitat bet din ben shogeg lemezid lefatro min hattashlumin: 
Vahalo hachovel mekalkel hu vechol hamekalkelin beshabbat peturin min hammita velamma nachshov ze hachovel avon sheyyesh bo mitat bet din. hoil veasa nachat ruach leyitzro hara beet shechaval bachavero hare hu kimtakken venimtza avon mita lefichach patur mittashlumin: 
Hachovel bachavero beyom hakkippurim afillu bemezid chayyav betashlumin. af al pi sheavar avera shehu chayyav aleha malkot. vahalo kol hamechuyyav malkot vetashlumin loke veeno meshallem sheen adam loke umeshallem. kach hem haddevarim bakkol chutz mechovel bachavero shehu meshallem shehare beferush ribbeta tora chovel bachavero letashlumin shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 19)</small> "rak shivto yitten": 
Hachovel beeved kenaani shello patur. chaval beeved ivri shello chayyav bechullan chutz min hashshevet. hachovel beeved kenaani shel chavero rabbo shel eved notel chamishsha devarim. vaafillu tziaro besam venitirappe bimhera hare kol refuato lerabbo: 
Kol eved sheyyatza lecherut vaadayin lo higgia get shichrur leyado en lo kenas. vaacherim shechavlu bo eno yachol lehotzi mehen leatzmo sheadayin lo gamar shichruro. velo haadon yachol lehotzi mehen shehare lo nishar [lo] bo kinyan. lefichach hammappil shen avdo veachar kach simme eno yotze beshinno veeno noten lo deme eno. veim tafas en motziin miyyado: 
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin shebbiyyesho adam o tziaro o shennegacho shor vechayyotze baellu. im ero ze bayyom shel rabbo lerabbo. bayyom shel atzmo leatzmo: 
Hachovel beeved ivri shel chavero chayyav bachamishsha devarim veyillakach bahen karka verabbo ochel peroteha. velichsheyyetze haeved lecherut yetze hassade mittachat rabbo. hizziko hezzek sheeno meakkev melacha kelal kegon shekkata rosh azno o rosh chatmo hakkol laeved veen lerabbo bahen perot: 
Hachovel bevat ketanna shel acherim im nezek happochet otah mikkaspah hu hare hu shel av. vechen shivtah shel av shehare maase yadeha vechesef mechiratah shel aviha hu. aval tzaar uvoshet verippuy hare hu shellah. vechen nezek sheeno pochatah mikkaspah hare hu shellah. vechen hachovel bevitto meshallem tzaar verippuy uvoshet: 
Hachovel beeshet ish hashshevet veharippuy levaalah vehatztzaar shellah. vehabboshet vehannezek im begaluy hu kegon shechaval befaneha uvetzavvarah o beyadeha uzerooteha hashshelish shellah ushene shelishim labbaal. veim basseter hu hannezek hashshelish labbaal ushene shelishim laishsha. shel baal notnin lo miyyad veshel ishsha yillakach bahen karka vehabbaal ochel perot: 
Bamme devarim amurim shechavlu bah acherim. aval habbaal shechaval beishto chayyav leshallem lah miyyad kol hannezek vechol habboshet vehatztzaar vehakkol shellah veen labbaal bahen perot. veim ratzta litten haddamim leacher notenet. vechaze horu haggeonim. vehabbaal merappe otah kederech shemmerappe kol chalyah: 
Vehammazzik ishto betashmish hammitta chayyav binzakeha: 
Haishsha shechavla bevalah im haya tosefet bichtubbatah mechayyevin otah limkor hattosefet levaalah betovat hanaa vegove mimmenna im ratza habbaal. veim ratza legarshah veligbot min hakkol gove. veim lo haya lah tosefet enah yechola limkor lo ikkar ketubbatah. sheasur lo laadam lashhot et ishto shaa achat belo ketubba kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah. ella im ratza habbaal kotev aleha shetar bidme chavalo o megarshah venotel mikketubbatah harauy lo: 
Hachovel bevanav haggedolim im en somchin al shulchano noten lahem miyyad. vehakketannim yillakach bahen karka benizkan vehen ochlin perotav. vechen haddin baacherim shechavlu bahen. veim hayu semuchin al shulchano vechaval bahen patur ben shehayu gedolim ben shehayu ketannim. veim chavlu bahen acherim baggedolim yitten lahem miyyad uvakketannim yillakach bahen karka vehen ochlin peroteha ad sheyyagdilu: 
Cheresh shote vekatan pegiatan raa. hachovel bahen chayyav vehen shechavlu baacherim peturin. af al pi shennitpatteach hacheresh venishtappa hashshote vehigdil hakkatan enam chayyavin leshallem shebbeshaa shechavlu bahen lo hayu bene daat: 
Haeved vehaishsha pegiatan raa hachovel bahen chayyav vehen shechavlu baacherim peturin. aval meshallemin leachar zeman im nitgarsha haishsha o met balah o nishtachrer haeved. shehare bene dea hen vahare hen kevaal chov sheen lo ma yigbe sheim heeshir chayyav leshallem: 
Avdo shel adam kegufo uvehemto kemamono. ketzad. hare shehinniach gachelet al lev avdo shel chavero umet o sheddechafo layyam o laesh vehu yachol laalot mishsham velo ala umet patur min hattashlumin. veim asa chen levehemat chavero keillu hinniach haggachelet al bigdo venisraf shehu chayyav leshallem. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Asur leadam lachavol ben beatzmo ben bachavero. velo hachovel bilvad ella kol hammakke adam kasher miyyisrael ben katan ben gadol ben ish ben ishsha derech nitztzayon hare ze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 3)</small> "lo yosif" <small>(Devarim 25 3)</small> "lehakkoto". im hizhira tora millehosif behakkaat hachote kal vachomer lemakke et hatztzaddik: 
Afillu lehagebiah yado al chavero asur vechol hammagbiah yado al chavero af al pi shello hikkahu hare ze rasha: 
Hammakke et chavero hakkaa sheen bah sheve peruta loke shehare en kan tashlumin kede sheyyihye lav ze nittan letashlumin. vaafillu hikka eved chavero hakkaa sheen bah sheve peruta loke shehare yeshno bemiktzat mitzvot. veakkum shehikka et yisrael chayyav mita shenneemar <small>(Shemot 2 12)</small> "vayyifen ko vacho" <small>(Shemot 2 12)</small> "vayyach et hammitzri": 
Kenas kansu chachamim leellu hashshotim baale zeroa sheyyihye hannechbal neeman venishba binkitat chefetz shezze chaval bo chaval ze venotel ma sherauy lo. vehu sheyyihyu sham edim. ketzad. hayu shene edim meidin oto shennichnas letoch yado shalem veyatza chavul velo rauhu beet shechaval bo vehu omer lo chavalti vehalla omer atta chavalta bi hare ze nishba venotel: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayta hammakka bemakom sheefshar lo lehakkot beatzmo o shehaya immahem shelishi sheefshar shezze hannechbal amar lo lachavol bo ulehitraem al acher. aval im en immahem acher vehayta hammakka bemakom sheeno yachol laasot beatzmo kegon shehayta neshicha ben ketefav vechayyotze baze hare ze notel belo shevua: 
Hoda hachovel shehu chaval meshallem chamishsha devarim shehare haedim hayu sham shennichnas letoch yado shalem bishat hammeriva veyatza chavul. aval im lo hayu sham edim kelal hu omer chavalta bi vehoda meatzmo patur min hannezek umin hatztzaar vechayyav beshevet uvevoshet uverippuy al pi atzmo. lefichach im kafar veamar lo chavalti nishba shevuat hesset: 
Velamma meshallem adam shelosha devarim ellu al pi atzmo. shehashshevet veharippuy mamon hu velo kenas. sheim lo yitten lo hare chissero mamon shehu mitrappe bo uvittel mimmelachto. vehabboshet lo higgia lo ella beshaa shehoda befanenu shehu chaval bo. shehannechbal shello chaval bo [bifne] adam en lo boshet vehodaato bevet din hi shebbiyyesha oto: 
Nimtzeta lamed sheen hefresh bevoshet ben boshet hammaggia lo im chaval bo bifne acherim uven boshet hammaggia lo beet shehoda bifne acherim shechaval bo. lefichach meshallem adam boshet al pi atzmo: 
Eno dome mazzik chavero begufo lemazzik mamono. shehammazzik mamon chavero kevan sheshshillem ma shehu chayyav leshallem nitkapper lo. aval chaval bachavero af al pi shennatan lo chamishsha devarim en mitkapper lo. vaafillu hikriv kol ele nevayot eno mitkapper lo velo nimchal avono ad sheyyevakkesh min hannechbal veyimchol lo: 
Veasur lannechbal lihyot achzari velo yimchol en zo derech zera yisrael ella kevan shebbikkesh mimmennu hachovel venitchannen lo paam rishona usheniyya veyada shehu shav mecheto venicham al raato yimchol lo. vechol hamemaher limchol hare hu meshubbach veruach chachamim nocha hemennu: 
Veod yesh hefresh ben nizke gufo lenizke mamono. shehaomer lachavero samme et eni keta et yadi al menat sheatta patur hare ze chayyav bachamishsha devarim shehaddavar yadua sheen adam rotze bechach. aval haomer lachavero kera et kesuti shevor et kaddi al menat sheatta patur hare ze patur. veim lo amar lo al menat sheatta patur hare ze chayyav leshallem af al pi shehirshahu lehashechit: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshebbau hakkelim leyado techilla betorat shemira. kegon shehayu sheulin o mufkadin etzlo veamar lo shevor ukera veasa chen chayyav leshallem ad sheyyomar lo al menat sheatta patur. aval im amar lo kach keli ze veshavro. beged ze vekaro. veasa chen hare ze patur: 
Haomer lachavero shevor kelav shel peloni al menat sheatta patur veasa hare ze chayyav leshallem. ucheillu amar lo samme eno shel peloni al menat sheatta patur. veaf al pi shehaose hu chayyav leshallem. hare ze haomer lo shuttafo baavon verasha hu. shehare hichshil ivver vechizzek yede ovre avera:

Hammazzik mamon chavero chayyav leshallem nezek shalem ben shehaya shogeg ben shehaya anus hare hu kemezid. ketzad. nafal min haggag veshavar et hakkelim o shennitkal keshehu mehallech venafal al hakkeli ushevaro chayyav nezek shalem. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 24 21)</small> "umakke vehema yeshallemenna" lo chillek hakkatuv ben shogeg lemezid: 
Veechad hahoreg behemto shel chavero o hashshover kelav o hakkorea begadav o kotzetz netiotav hakkol din echad hu: 
Bamme devarim amurim birshut hannizzak. aval birshut hammazzik eno chayyav leshallem ella im hizzik bezadon aval bishgaga o beones patur. vechen im hayu shenehen birshut o shenehem shello birshut vehizzik echad mehen mamon chavero shello bechavvana patur: 
Haya ole bassullam venishmeta sheliva mittachtav venafla vehizzika. im lo hayta mehuddeket vachazaka chayyav. hayta chazaka umehuddeket venishmeta o shehitlia hare ze patur shezzo makka bide shamayim hi. vechen kol kayyotze baze. kol ellu haddevarim birshut hannizzak aval birshut hammazzik patur ad sheyyitkavven lehazzik kemo shebbearnu: 
Hare shemmille chatzar chavero kadde yayin veshemen afillu hichnisam birshut hoil velo kibbel alav baal hechatzer lishmor hare ze nichnas veyotze kedarko vechol sheyyishtabber min hakkaddim bichnisato uvitziato hare hu patur alehen. veim shevaran bechavvana afillu hichnisam baal hakkaddim shello birshut hare ze chayyav leshallem. [vechen kol kayyotze baze]: 
Shor sheala al gabbe shor lehargo birshut hammazzik shehu baal hattachton ben shehaya tam ben shehaya muad uva baal hattachton veshamat et shoro lehatztzilo venafal elyon umet hare ze patur: 
Dechafo leelyon umet im haya yachol leshamto velo shemato hare ze chayyav. veim lo haya yachol leshamto hare ze patur: 
Shenayim shehayu mehallechin birshut harabbim ze ba bechavito veze ba bekorato venishbera chavito shel ze bekorato shel ze patur shellaze reshut lehallech velaze reshut lehallech. haya baal hakkora rishon uvaal hechavit acharon venishbera chavit bakkora patur. veim amad baal hakkora lanuach mikkoved massao chayyav. veim hizhir levaal hechavit veamar lo amod patur. amad letakken massao hare hu kimhallech ufatur. veaf al pi shello hizhir levaal hechavit, shehu tarud bedarko. haya baal hechavit rishon uvaal kora acharon venishbera chavit bakkora chayyav shezze kemo sheshshevaro beyado bechavvana. veim amad baal chavit lanuach patur. veim hizhir levaal hakkora veamar lo amod hare ze chayyav. veim amad letakken massao af al pi shello hizhir levaal hakkora hare hu chayyav. vechen ze ba benero veze ba befishtano. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shenayim shehayu mehallechin birshut harabbim echad ratz veechad mehallech vehuzzak echad mehen bachavero shello bechavvana. ze haratz chayyav mippene shehu meshanne. veim haya erev shabbat ben hashshemashot patur mippene shebbirshut hu ratz kede shello tikkanes hashshabbat vehu eno panuy. hayu shenehem ratzim vehuzzeku ze baze shenehem peturin vaafillu bishar hayyamim: 
Echad hammazzik beyado o shezzarak even o yara chetz vehizzik bo o sheppatar mayim al chavero o al hakkelim vehizzik o sherak o na vehizzik bechicho venio beet shehalchu mikkocho hare ze kemazzik beyado vehem toladot shel adam. aval im nach harok vehakkiach al haaretz veachar kach nitkal bahen adam hare ze chayyav mishshum boro. shekkol takkala toledet bor hi kemo shebbearnu: 
Lotesh shehaya makke befattish veyatza getz mittachat happattish vehizzik hare ze chayyav kemi shezzarak even o chetz. vechen habbanay shekkibbel alav et hakkotel lesatro veshavar et haavanim o hizzik chayyav. haya soter mitztzad ze venafal mitztzad acher patur. veim mechamat hammakka chayyav shezze kezorek chetz vehizzik bo hu: 
Hakkovesh behemat chavero bemayim o shennafla umenaah millaalot ad shemmeta bammayim. o shehinnichah bachamma vetzimtzem aleha hammakom kede shello timtza tzel ad sheharagatta hachamma. chayyav leshallem. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shenayim shehemitu et habbehema keachat o shavru et hakkeli keachat meshalleshin benehen: 
Chamishsha shehinnichu chamesh chavilot al habbehema velo meta uva ze haacharon vehinniach chavilato aleha umeta. im hayta mehallechet beotan hachavilot umishshehosif ze chavilato amda velo halcha haacharon chayyav. veim mittechilla lo hayta mehallechet haacharon patur. veim en yadua kullan meshallemin beshave: 
Vechen chamishsha sheyyashvu al hakkisse velo nishbar uva acharon veyashav alav venishbar af al pi shehaya rauy lehishshaver bahen kodem sheyyashav hoil vekerev et shevirato haacharon chayyav. shehare omrim lo illu lo nismachta alenu hayinu omdim kodem sheyyishshaver. veim yashvu keachat venishbar kullan chayyavin. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Adam veshor sheddachafu behema o adam o kelim o behemat pesule hammukdashin labbor vehuzzak hannidchaf babbor o met o nishtabberu hakkelim. leinyan nizke adam o hezzek behema shelashtan chayyavin haadam haddochef uvaal hashshor uvaal habbor umeshalleshin benehen. leinyan deme veladot vearbaa devarim adam chayyav uvaal hashshor uvaal habbor peturin. leinyan kofer usheloshim shel eved baal hashshor chayyav veadam uvaal habbor peturin. leinyan kelim ufesule hammukdashin adam uvaal hashshor chayyavin uvaal habbor patur:
